a: Velema leh middishmuel, deamar shemuel: maliach hare hu keroteach, vechavush hare hu kimvushshal!
I middishmuel, hava amena: hane mille – daman, aval tziran verotvan – la, kamashma lan.
Metivi: dag tahor shemmelacho im dag tame – muttar. may lav shehayu shenehen meluchin? la, kegon shehaya tahor maliach vetame tafel.

Veha middekatane sefa: aval im haya tahor maliach vetame tafel, mikkelal deresha besheshshenehem meluchin askinan! paroshe ka mefaresh: tahor shemmelacho im dag tame – muttar, ketzad? shehaya tahor maliach vetame tafel.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach resha shenehem meluchim – hasheta shenehem meluchim shere, tahor maliach vetame tafel mibbaya?

I mishshum ha la irya, tena sefa legalloye resha, dela tema resha tahor maliach vetame tafel, aval shenehem meluchin asur, tena sefa tahor maliach vetame tafel, mikkelal deresha shenehen meluchin, vaafillu hachi shere.
Ta shema missefa desefa: aval im haya tame maliach vetahor tafel – asur. tame maliach vetahor tafel hu deasur, ha shenehen meluchin – shere.
Ayyeyde ditna resha: tahor maliach vetame tafel, tena name sefa: tame maliach vetahor tafel.
(Siman: bisra demannach nafkuta).

Amar shemuel: en habbasar yotze mide damo, ella im ken molcho yafe yafe, umedicho yafe yafe. ittemar: rav huna amar: moleach umediach. bematnita tena: mediach umoleach umediach. vela peligi, ha dechalleh be tabbacha, ha dela challeh be tabbacha. rav dimi minnehardea malach leh bemilcha gelalnita, umenappetz leh.
Amar rav mesharsheya: en machazikin dam bivne meayim. targema akkarkesha umeayyay vehadera dechanta.
Amar shemuel: en mannichin basar maliach ella al gabbe keli menukkav.
Rav sheshet malach leh garma garma. tere may tama la? mishshum defaresh mehay uvala hay? chad name paresh mehay gisa uvala hay gisa! ella la shena.
Amar shemuel, mishshum rabbi chiyyay: hashshover mafraktah shel behema kodem shettetze nafshah – hare ze machbid et habbasar, vegozel et habberiyyot, umavlia dam baevarim.
Ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? machbid et habbasar, vegozel et habberiyyot mishshum demavlia dam baevarim – ha ledideh shappir dame, o dilma ledideh name asir? teku.
Mishna hammaale et haof im haggevina al hashshulchan – eno over belo taase.
Gemara ha ochlo – over belo taase, shema minna: besar of bechalav deorayyta! ema: hammaale et haof im haggevina al hashshulechan – eno ba lide lo taase.

Mishna besar behema tehora bachalev behema tehora – asur levashshel veasur bahanaa. besar behema tehora bachalev behema temea, besar behema temea bachalev behema tehora – muttar levashshel umuttar bahanaa. rabbi akiva omer: chayya vaof enam min hattora, shenneemar "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo" shalosh peamim – perat lechayya, uleof, uvehema temea.

Rabbi yose haggelili omer: neemar "lo tochlu chol nevela", veneemar "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo", et sheasur mishshum nevela asur levashshel bechalav. of sheasur mishshum nevela, yachol yehe asur levashshel bechalav? talmud lomar "bachalev immo" – yatza of sheen lo chalev em.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi elazar: amar kera "vayyishlach yehuda et gedi haizzim",
b: Kan gedi izzim, ha kol makom shenneemar gedi setam – afillu para verachel bammashma.
Velelaf minneh? ketiv kera acharina: "veet orot gedaye haizzim" – kan "gedaye haizzim", ha kol makom shenneemar "gedi" setam – afillu para verachel bammashma.
Velelaf minneh? havu lehu shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad – en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar? tere miute ketivi: "izzim", "haizzim".
Amar shemuel: "gedi" – lerabbot et hachelev, "gedi" – lerabbot et hammeta, "gedi" – lerabbot et hashshelil.
"Gedi" – lehotzi et haddam, "gedi" – lehotzi et hashshilya, "gedi" – lehotzi et hattemea.
"Bachalev immo" – velo bachalev zachar, "bachalev immo" – velo bachalev shechuta, "bachalev immo" – velo bachalev temea.

Ha telata "gedi" ketivi, vaanan shitta darshinan! kasavar shemuel issur chal al issur, veissur chelev umeta mechad kera nafki. dam name lav "gedi" hu, veshilya name pirsha bealma hu. pashu lehu tere: chad lerabbot et hashshelil, vechad lemaote behema temea.

Vesavar shemuel issur chal al issur? vehaamar shemuel mishshum rabbi elazar: minnayin lechohen tame sheachal teruma temea sheeno bemita? shenneemar "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu" – perat lazo shemmechullelet veomedet.
Ibbaet ema: bealma issur chal al issur, veshane hatam demiet rachamana "umetu vo". ibbaet ema: bealma kasavar shemuel en issur chal al issur, veshane hacha derabbi rachamana "gedi".
Veibbaet ema: ha dideh, ha derabbeh.

Bea minneh rav achadvuy bar amme merav: hamevashshel bachalev gedi shello henika, mahu? amar leh: middeitztericha lishmuel lememar "bachalev immo" – velo bachalev zachar, zachar hu dela ate lichlal em, aval hay, kevan deva lichlal em – asur.

Ittemar: hamevashshel chelev bechalav, rabbi amme verabbi assi – chad amar: loke, vechad amar: eno loke. lema beha kamippalgi, deman deamar loke kasavar: issur chal al issur, uman deamar eno loke kasavar: en issur chal al issur.

La, dechulle alma en issur chal al issur, aachila dechulle alma la peligi dela lake, ki peligi abbishshul. man deamar loke – chad issura hu, uman deamar eno loke – lehachi appeka rachamana laachila bilshon bishshul,

a: Kevan deal achila la lake, abbishshul name la lake.

Veikka deamri: abbishshul – kulle alma la peligi delake, ki peligi aachila. man deamar eno loke – deha en issur chal al issur, uman deamar loke – lehachi appeka rachamana laachila bilshon bishshul, kevan deabbishshul lake – aachila name lake.
Veibbaet ema: mar amar chada, umar amar chada, vela peligi.
Metivi: hamevashshel beme chalav – patur, dam shebbishshelo bechalav – patur, haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim shebbishshelan bechalav – patur.
Happiggul, vehannotar, vehattame, shebbishshelan bechalav – chayyayv!
Hay tanna savar issur chal al issur.

Hamevashshel beme chalav patur, mesayyay leh leresh lakish, ditnan: me chalav hare hen kechalav, vehammochal hare hu keshemen. amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella lehacheshir et hazzeraim, aval leinyan bishshul basar bechalav – me chalav eno kechalav.
Tanu rabbanan: "bachalev immo" – en li ella bachalev immo, bachalev para verachel minnayin?
Amarta, kal vachomer: uma immo, shello neesra immo beharebaa – neesra immo bevishshulo, para verachel, shenneesru immo beharebaa – eno din shenneesru immo bevishshulo! talmud lomar "bachalev immo".
Veha lema li kera? ha atya leh!

Amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar meikkara dedina pircha, mehecha ka mayytet la? meimmo, ma leimmo shekken neesra immo bishchita, tomar befara shello neesra immo bishchita? talmud lomar "bachalev immo".
Tanya iddach: "bachalev immo" – en li ella bachalev immo, bachalev achoto gedola minnayin?

Amarta kal vachomer, uma immo shennichnesa immo ledir lehitasser – neesra immo bevishshul, achoto shello nichnesa immo ledir lehitasser – eno din shenneesra immo bevishshul! talmud lomar "bachalev immo".

Veha lema li kera, ha atya lay? amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar meikkara dedina pircha, mehecha ka mayytet la? meimmo, ma leimmo, shekken neesra immo bishchita, tomar baachoto gedola, shello neesra immo bishchita? talmud lomar "bachalev immo".
Ashkechan achoto gedola, achoto ketanna minnayin? atya mibbenayya.
Mehe tete? tete meimmo – ma leimmo shekken neesra immo bishchita? achoto gedola tochiach. ma laachoto gedola shello nichnesa immo ledir lehitasser? immo tochiach.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: shehu basar, veasur levashshel bechalav, af ani avi achoto ketanna, shehu basar, veasur levashshel bechalav.
I hachi, achoto gedola name tete mibbenayya.
In hachi name, ella "bachalev immo" lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "bachalev immo" – en li ella bachalev immo,
b: Hi atzmah bachalavah minnayin? amarta kal vechomer: uma bimkom shello neesar peri im peri bishchita, neesar peri im haem bishchita, mekom shenneesar peri im peri bevishshul – eno din shenneesar peri im haem bevishshul? talmud lomar "bachalev immo".
Ha lema li kera, ha atya la? amar rav achadvuy bar amme: mishshum deikka lememar, sus ben suseya achi pirda yochiach, sheasur peri im peri, umuttar peri im haem.
Hatam, zera haav hu deka garem.
Deha pered ben suseya achi pirda yochiach, shemmuttar peri im peri, veasur peri im haem.
Ella amar mar bereh deravina: mishshum deikka lememar, eved ben shifcha achi meshuchereret yochiach, sheasur peri im peri, umuttar peri im haem!
Hatam get shichrur hu deka garem, deha eved ben meshuchereret achi shifcha yochiach, shemmuttar peri im peri, veasur peri im haem.

Ella amar rav idi bar avin: mishshum deikka lememar, kile zeraim yochichu, sheasur peri im peri, umuttar peri im haem. kelum neesar peri im peri ella al yede haem? deha chitte useare bechadda vela mittasru.
Ella amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar, ma lifri im peri, shekken shene gufim, tomar bifri im haem, shekken guf echad, mishshum hachi itzterich kera.
Amar rav ashe: minnayin levasar bechalav sheasur baachila? shenneemar "lo tochal kol toeva" – kol shettiavti lach hare hu beval tochal.

Veen li ella baachila, bahanaa minnayin? kidrabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: kol makom shenneemar "lo yochal", "lo tochal", "lo tochlu" – echad issur achila veechad issur hanaa bammashma, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv, kederech shepparat lecha binvela lagger bintina velaggoy bimchira.

Detanya: "lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri" – en li ella leger bintina, ulegoy bimchira; leger bimchira minnayin? talmud lomar: "lagger tittenenna o machor".

Legoy bintina minnayin? talmud lomar: "tittenenna… o machor lenochri". nimtza echad ger veechad goy, ben bimchira ben bintina, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: devarim kichtavan, leger bintina velaggoy bimchira.

May tama derabbi yehuda? i salka datach kidkaamar rabbi meir, lichtov rachamana "lo tochlu chol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah umachor" – "o" lema li? shema minna lidvarim kichtavan hu daata: leger bintina, velaggoy bimchira.

Verabbi meir amar lach: hay "o" lehakedim netina deger limchira degoy. verabbi yehuda, lehakedim netina deger limchira degoy la tzerich kera, sevara hu: ze atta metzvvev lehacheyoto, veze i atta metzvvev lehachayoto.
(Siman: shabbat, choresh, vechile zeraim, oto veet beno, veshilluach hakken).
Ella meatta,

a: Maase shabbat littasru, deha "tiavti lecha" hu.
Amar kera: "ki kodesh hi lachem" – hi kodesh, veen maaseha kodesh.
Choresh beshor uvachamor, vechosem pi fara vedash bah, littasru, deha "tiavti lecha" hu!
Hasheta, uma shabbat dachamira, maaseha muttarim; hane, lo kol shekken?
Kile zeraim littasru, deha "tiavti lecha" hu! middegalli rachamana gabbe kile hakkerem "pen tikdash" – "pen tukad esh", mikkelal dechile zeraim sheru.

Veema: kile cherem asurin ben baachila ben bahanaa, kile zeraim baachila asiri, bahanaa sheru. ittakkush lechile vehema, dichtiv: "behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim", ma behemtecha – hayyotze mimmenna mutteret, af sadcha – hayyotze mimmennu muttar.
Vechile vehema gufayyhu mena lan? middaasar rachamana kilayim laggavoah, mikkelal dilhedyot shere.
Oto veet beno littesar! middaasar rachamana mechussar zeman laggavoah, mikkelal dilhedyot shere.
Shilluach hakken littesar! lo amra tora "shallach" letakkala.

Amar resh lakish: minnayin levasar bechalav sheasur? talmud lomar "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal", sheen talmud lomar "mevushshal". ma talmud lomar "mevushshal"? lomar lecha yesh lecha bishshul acher shehu kaze, vee ze – ze basar bechalav.
Amar lo rabbi yochanan:
b: Keura zo sheshshana rabbi? "lo tochlennu" – bevasar bechalav hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer bevasar bechalav hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella beechad mikkol haissurin shebbattora? amarta: tze ulemad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen, davar hallamed meinyano. bamme hakkatuv medabber? bishne minin, af kan bishne minin.
I mehahi – hava amena: hane mille baachila, aval bahanaa – la; kamashma lan.
Verabbi, bahanaa mena leh? nafka leh mehacha: neemar kan "ki am kadosh atta laAdonai", veneemar lehallan "velo yihye kadesh bivne yisrael", ma lehallan bahanaa, af kan bahanaa.
Deve rabbi eliezer tana: "lo tochlu chol nevela [vegomer]", amra tora: keshettimkerenna – lo tevashshelenna vetimkerenna.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo" shalosh peamim, echad leissur achila, veechad leissur hanaa, veechad leissur bishshul.

Tanya, isi ben yehuda omer: minnayin levasar bechalav sheasur? neemar kan "ki am kadosh atta", veneemar lehallan "veanshe kodesh tihyun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu", ma lehallan asur, af kan asur.
Veen li ella baachila, bahanaa minnayin? amarta kal vechomer: uma orla shello neevda bah avera – asura bahanaa, basar bechalav shenneevda bo avera – eno din sheasur bahanaa!
Ma leorla, shekken lo hayta lah sheat hakkosher.
Chametz bappesach yochiach, shehayta lo sheat hakkosher, veasur bahanaa. ma lechametz bappesach, shekken anush karet.
Kile hakkerem yochichu, sheen anush karet, veasur bahanaa.

Lema li gezera shava? layyte kulla bekal vachomer meorla: uma orla, shello neevda bah avera, asura ben baachila ben bahanaa; basar bechalav, shenneevda bo avera, eno din sheasur ben baachila ben bahanaa!
Mishshum deikka lememar: choresh beshor uvachamor, vechosem pi fara vedash bah yochiach, shenneevda bahem avera usheru.
Lema li lememar "kile hakkerem yochichu", lema "orla tochiach", velihdar dina velete bema hatztzad.
Amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar, nevela tochiach, sheasura baachila umutteret bahanaa.
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amrinan mishshemeh deresh lakish: kol "ma hatztzad" – miggufo parchinan, mealma la parchinan.
I hachi, tete bema hatztzad? mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken giddule karka.
I hachi, hasheta name ikka lemifrach: ma lechile hakkerem, shekken giddule karka?
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amrinan mishshemeh deresh lakish: kol ma hatztzad parchinan kol dehu, lo im amarta chada mechada – kal vachomer parchinan, kol dehu – la parchinan.
Velifroch lechullehu, ma lechullehu shekken giddule karka!
Ella, amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe, hachi amrinan mishshemeh deresh lakish:

a: Chada mechada kulla vechumera parchinan, kol dehu la parchinan, chada mittarte afillu kol dehu parchinan.
Chada mittelat, i hadar dina veate bema hatztzad – parchinan kol dehu, vei la – kulla vechumera parchinan, kol dehu la parchinan.
Velifroch: ma lechile hakkerem, shekken lo hayta lahen sheat hakkosher? amar rav adda bar ahava: zot omeret – kile hakkerem ikkaran neesar, vehayta lahen sheat hakkosher kodem hasherasha.
Metiv rav shemaya bar zeera: hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem, im hosif matayim – asur. hosif – in, lo hosif – la.
Amar abbaye: tere kerae ketivi, ketiv "pen tikdash hammelea", uchetiv "hazzera".
Ha ketzad? zarua meikkaro – behasherasha, zarua uva, hosif – in, lo hosif – la.

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, shenneemar: "ki am kadosh atta", veneemar lehallan: "veanshe kodesh tihyun li".
Ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa.
Rabbi akiva omer: chayya vaof vechulei. hane – ha appekinhu lichdishmuel.
Kasavar rabbi akiva: issur chal al issur, chelev umeta la tzerichi kera, shelil – gedi mealleya hu, iyyaytaru lehu kullehu – perat lechayya, veof, velivhema temea.
Rabbi yose haggelili omer: neemar "lo tochlu". may ikka ben rabbi yose haggelili lerabbi akiva?
Ikka benayyhu chayya: rabbi yose haggelili savar chayya deorayyta, verabbi akiva savar chayya derabbanan.
Ibbaet ema, of ikka benayyhu: rabbi akiva savar chayya vaof enan min hattora, ha midderabbanan asiri, verabbi yose haggelili savar of afillu midderabbanan name la asir.
Tanya name hachi: bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer hayu kortin etzim laasot pechamin laasot barzel, bimkomo shel rabbi yose haggelili hayu ochlin besar of bechalav.
Levi ikkela leve yosef rishba, ayyto lekammeh resha detavvavsa bachalava, vela amar lehu vela midde. ki ata lekammeh derabbi, amar leh: ammay la teshammetinhu?
Amar leh: atreh derabbi yehuda ben betera hu, veamena: derash lehu kerabbi yose haggelili, deamar: yatza of sheen lo chalev em.
Mishna kevat goy veshel nevela – hare zo asura. hammaamid beor shel keva keshera,
b: Im yesh benoten taam – hare zo asura. keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa – kevatah asura. terefa sheyyanka min hechsherah – kevatah mutteret, mippene shekkanus bemeeha.
Gemara attu kevat goy lav nevela hi? amar rav huna: hacha belokeach gedi min haggoy askinan, vechayyshinan shemma yanak min hatterefa.
Umi chayyshinan shemma yanak min hatterefa? vehatnan: lokchim betzim min haggoyim, veen choshshin lo mishshum nevela velo mishshum terefa! ella ema: chayyshinan shemma yanak min hattemea.
Umay shena terefa dela chayyshinan, umay shena temea dechayyshinan? terefa la shechicha, temea shechicha.

I shechicha, afillu gabbe didan nechush! anan devadlinan minnayyhu, vechi chazenan lehu mafreshinan lehu – la gezaru behu rabbanan. inhu dela bedili minnayyhu, vechi chazu lehu la mafreshi lehu – gezaru behu rabbanan.
Ushemuel amar: chada katane, kevat shechitat goy – nevela.
Umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: mippene ma asru gevinat haggoyim – mippene shemmaamidin otah beor kevat nevela. ha keva gufa sharya!
La kashya: kan – kodem chazara, kan – leachar chazara.
Keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa [vechulei]. veha katane resha: kevat goy veshel nevela hare zo asura?
Amar rav chisda: resha nire keochel nevelot, hacha ikka shechita.
Amar leh rava: velav kol dechen hu? uma nevela dimisa, dei sharet leh kevatah la ate lemechal minna, amrat la. terefa shechuta, dei sharet ate lemechal minna, lo kol shekken?
Ella amar rav yitzchak, amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya, kan kodem chazara, kan leachar chazara, umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: maamidin bekevat nevelot, veen maamidin bekevat shechitat goy. amar lefanav rabbi shimon bar abba: keman? kerabbi eliezer, deamar setam machshevet goy laavoda zara.
Amar leh: veella keman?
Ki ata rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak, amar rabbi yochanan: maamidin ben bekevat nevela, ben bekevat shechitat goy, shello lachosh ledivre rabbi eliezer.

Vehilcheta: en maamidin baor kevat nevela, aval maamidin bekevat nevela, uvekevat shechitat goy, uvekevat keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa, vechol shekken bekevat terefa sheyyanka min hakkeshera. may tama? chalav hamechunnas bah pirsha bealma hu.
Mishna chomer bachelev mibbaddam, vechomer baddam mibbachelev. chomer bachelev – shehachelev

a: Moalin bo, vechayyayvin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame, ma sheen ken baddam.
Vechomer baddam, shehaddam noheg bivhema vechayya vaof, ben temeim uven tehorim, vechelev eno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi yannay: deamar kera "kaasher yuram mishshor zevach hashshelamim", vechi ma lamadnu mishshor zevach hashshelamim meatta?
Hare ze ba lelammed, venimtza lamed, makkish shor zevach hashshelamim lefar kohen mashiach: ma par kohen mashiach yesh bo meila, af shor zevach hashshelamim yesh bo meila.
Amar leh rabbi chanina: keura zo sheshshana rabbi, "kol chelev laAdonai" – lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila?
Amar abbaye: itzterich, dei ketav rachamana "chelev", hava amena: chelev – in, yoteret ushete chelayot – la. ketav rachamana "kaasher yuram".
Vei ketav rachamana "kaasher yuram", hava amena: chelev alya deleta beshor – la, ketav rachamana "kol chelev".
Amar leh rav mari lerav zevid: i alya ikkeray "chelev", tittesar baachila! amar leh: alecha amar kera "kol chelev shor vechesev vaez" – davar hashshave beshor vechesev vaez.
Rav ashe amar: "chelbo haalya" ikkeray, "chelev" setama la ikkeray. ella meatta, lo yimalu bah! ella mechavvavrta kidrav zevid.
Ma sheen ken baddam, mena hane mille? amar ulla: deamar kera "lachem", shellachem yehe. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "lechapper" – lechappara netattiv, velo limila.
Verabbi yochanan amar, amar kera: "hu", hu lifne kappara kilachar kappara, ma leachar kappara en bo meila, af lifne kappara en bo meila.
Veema hu leachar kappara kelifne kappara: ma lifne kappara – yesh bo meila, af leachar kappara – yesh bo meila! en lecha davar shennaasa mitzvato umoalin bo.
Vela? vahare terumat haddeshen, denaasa mitzvato, umoalin bo, dichtiv: "vesamo etzel hammizbeach"!
Mishshum dehavey terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna (shene ketuvin habbain keechad), vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri: "vehinnicham sham" – melammed shetteunin geniza, ella lerabbi dosa deamar shello yishtammesh bahen leyom hakkippurim acher, may ikka lememar?
Ella, mishshum dehavey terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvim habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvim habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar? tere
b: Miute ketivi: hacha ketiv "vesamo", hatam ketiv "haarufa".
Utelata kerae lema li bedam?
Chad lemaote minnotar, vechad lemaote mimmeila, vechad lemaote mittumea.
Aval mippiggul la tzerich kera, ditnan: kol sheyyesh lo mattirin, ben leadam uven lemizbeach – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, vedam gufeh mattir hu.
Hadaran alach kol habbasar.
Mishna haor, veharotev, vehakkefe, vehaalal, vehaatzamot, vehaggidin, vehakkarnayim, vehattelafayim –
Mitztarfin letamme tumeat ochalin, aval lo tumeat nevelot.

Kayyotze bo, hashshochet behema temea legoy umefarkeset, metammea tumeat ochalin, aval lo tumeat nevelot ad shettamut o ad sheyyattiz et roshah. ribba letamme tumeat ochalin mimma sheribba letamme tumeat nevelot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: haalal hamechunnas, im yesh bo kezayit bemakom echad – chayyayv alav.
Gemara tenena leha detanu rabbanan: shomrim letumea kalla, velo shomrim letumea chamura.
Shomrim letumea kalla menalan? detana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera zerua" – kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria: chitta biklippatah, useora biklippatah, vaadashim biklippatan.
Velo shomrim letumea chamura menalan? detanu rabbanan: "benivlatah" – velo beor sheen alav kezayit basar.

a: Yachol hannogea keneged basar meachorav lo yehe tame? talmud lomar: "yitma".
May kaamar? amar rava, veamri la kedi: chassore michassera vehachi katane: "benivlatah" – velo beor sheen alav kezayit basar, veor mashlimo lichzayit.
Yachol sheani motzi af or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar, hannogea keneged basar meachorav yachol lo yehe tame, vaafillu maase yad name la aved.
Talmud lomar "yitma".
Tenan hatam: kol shehu yad velo shomer – tame umetamme, veeno mitztaref.
Shomer, veaf al pi sheeno yad – tame umetamme umitztaref; lo yad velo shomer – lo tame velo metamme.
Yadot hecha ketivi? dichtiv "vechi yuttan mayim al zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu lachem", "lachem" – lechol shebbetzorchechem, lerabbot et hayyadot.
Uchetiv: "vechi yamut min habbehema asher hi lachem", "lachem" – lechol shebbetzorchechem, lerabbot et hayyadot, yad lehachenis ulehotzi.
Shomer lehachenis ulehotzi – la tzerich kera, kal vachomer miyyad ate: uma yad, sheenah meginna – machneset umotzia, shomer – lo kol shekken?
Shomer dichtav rachamana, lema li? shema minna letzaref.
Veema: yad lehachenis velo lehotzi, shomer lehachenis ulehotzi, aval yad lehotzi veshomer letzaref – la.
Yad lehachenis velo lehotzi, la matzet amrat, hasheta ayyole meayyeyla, appoke mibbaya?!
Veema: yad lehotzi velo lehachenis, shomer lehotzi ulehachnis, aval yad lehachenis veshomer letzaref – la.
Yad yattira ketiv, "tannur vechirayim yuttatz vegomer".
Lachem" – lechol shebbetzorchechem, lerabbot et hayyadot.
He minnayyhu meyaytar?
Lichtov rachamana bizraim, veleto hanach minnayyhu – ma lizraim, shekken tumeatan merubba.
Lichtov rachamana betannur, velete hanach minneh – ma letannur, shekken metamme meaviro.
Lichtov rachamana binvela, velete hanach minna – ma linvela shekken metammea adam, umetammea bemassa, vetumea yotza miggufah.
Chada mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte.
He tete? la lichtov rachamana bizraim, vetete mehanach! ma lehanach – shekken mittammein shello behechsher, tomar bizraim – sheen mittammein ella behechsher!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: perot shello hucheshru, ketannur shello nigmera melachto dame.
Ella parech hachi: ma lehanach, shekken mittammein shello bingia, tomar bizraim, sheen mittammein ella bingia!
La lichtov rachamana betannur, vetete mehanach, ma lehanach shekken ochel.
La lichtov rachamana binvela, vetete mehanach? in hachi name. ella yad dinvela lema li? im eno inyan leyad nevela, tenehu inyan leyad dealma.
Yad lehachenis, yad lehotzi, shomer letzaref.
Veakkatti, yad dinvela itzterich, dei la ketav rachamana binvela, hava amena: dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma hanach la metammu adam, af nevela la metammea adam.
Ella, yad dinvela mitzrach tzerich, veshomer dinvela hu dela tzerich. lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana? i leitzterofe – amrat la mitztaref, ulehotzi – kal vachomer miyyad ate.
Ella, im en inyan leshomer dinvela, tenehu inyan leyad dinvela, veim eno inyan leyad dinvela, tenehu inyan leyad dealma: yad lehotzi, yad lehachenis, veshomer letzaref.
b: Veema: im eno inyan leshomer dinvela, tenehu inyan leshomer dealma, shomer lehachenis veshomer letzaref, aval yad lehachenis lo!
Ella, meikkara ki ketiva yad, ahachnasa ketiva.
Ella shomer dinvela, lema li? legufeh.
Ulemay? i leitzterofe – amrat la mitztaref! i lehachenis ulehotzi – kal vachomer miyyad atya! milleta deatya bekal vechomer – tarach vechatav la kera.
I hachi, shomer dealma, ema lach: lehachenis, umilleta deate bekal vachomer – tarach vechatav la kera.
Hecha deikka lemidrash, darshinan.
Rav chaviva amar: shane shomer dinvela, kevan demaase yad ka aved, ayyad shadenan leh.
Matkef la rav yehuda bar yishmael, ha ditnan: happitma shel rimmon mitztarefet, vehannetz shello en mitztaref.
Veammay? keri kan "al kol zera zerua", velekka!
Vetu, ha ditnan: haor veharotev vehakkefe vechulei. mitztaref letamme tumeat ochalim – menalan?
Ella telata kerae ketivi: "al kol zera", "zerua", "asher yizzarea", chad leshomer dizraim, vechad leshomer deilanot, iddach leshomer basar uvetzim vedagim.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe, amar rav: yesh yad letumea, veen yad lehechsher.
Verabbi yochanan amar: yesh yad letumea ulehechsher.
Bemay kamippalgi? ibbaet ema sevara, ibbaet ema kera.
Ibbaet ema kera, mar savar: mikra nidrash lefanav, velo lifne fanav.
Umar savar: mikra nidrash lefanav, velifne fanav.
Ibbaet ema sevara, mar savar: hechsher techillat tumea hu, umar savar: hechsher lav techillat tumea hu.
Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: keshem sheyyesh yad letumea, kach yesh yad lehechsher, ucheshem sheen mekabbelin tumea ella lichsheyyittalshu, kach en mekabbelin hechsher ella ad sheyyittalshu.
Amar rav: en yad lefachot mikkezayit, veen shomer lefachot mikkefol.
Verabbi yochanan amar: yesh yad lefachot mikkezayit, veyesh shomer lefachot mikkefol.
Metivi: shete atzamot, vaalehen shene chatzae zetim, vehichnis rashehen (shenayim) [hashshenayim] levayit, vehabbayit maahil alehen – habbayit tame.
Yehuda ben nakosa omer mishshum rabbi yaakov: heach shene atzamot mitztarfin lichzayit?

a: Verav hay bemay mokem la? i beyad, kashya resha!
I beshomer – kashya sefa.
Ibbaet ema beshomer, ibbaet ema beyad.
Ibbaet ema beyad, vehu deamar kerabbi yehuda ben nakosa, veibbaet ema beshomer, vehu deamar ketanna kamma.
Verabbi yochanan amar: kulla beyad, vehu deamar ketanna kamma.
Ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer, kulit sheyyesh aleha kezayit basar – goreret kullah letumea. acherim omrim: afillu en aleha ella kefol – goreret kullah letumea.
Verav hay bemay mokem la? i beyad – kashya sefa, i beshomer – kashya resha.
Ibbaet ema beyad – vehu deamar kerabbi yehuda, veibbaet ema beshomer – kaacherim.
Verabbi yochanan amar: kulla beshomer, vehu deamar kaacherim.
Acherim, ha "kefol" ka amri!
Ayyeyde dekaamar tanna kamma shiura, kaamri inhu name shiura.
Amar rava: dayka name divshomer askinan, dekatane "kulit", shema minna.
Ittemar, rabbi chanina amar: zehu shiur, verabbi yochanan amar: en ze shiur.
En ze shiur, veha katane "kefol"! ayyeyde dekaamar tanna kamma shiura, kaamri inhu name shiura.
Ta shema: rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol, umetamme beshel kitnit, mippene sherotze bemishmuyshan!
Kidamar rav acha bereh derava, bekulecha, umishshum yad.
Hacha name bekulecha, umishshum yad, umay "bemishmuyshan"? betashmishan.
Ta shema, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea", kederech shebbene adam motziin – chitta biklippatah, useora biklippatah, vaadashim biklippatan!
Beriyya – shane.
Bae rav oshaya:
b: Shene shomrin mahu sheyyitztarfu?
Hechi dame? illema beze al gav ze – umi ikka shomer al gav shomer?
Vehatnan: rabbi yehuda omer: shalosh kelippot bevatzal – penimit, ben shelema ben kedura – mitztarefet; emtzait, shelema – mitztarefet, kedura – en mitztarefet; chitzona, ben kach uven kach – tehora.
Rav oshaya, shomer ochel shechilleko kamibbaya leh.
Kevan dehay la maggen ahay, vehay la maggen ahay, la mitztaref.
O dilma, kevan dehay maggen addideh, vehay maggen addideh, mitztarfin.
Ta shema: rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol, umetamme beshel kitnit, mippene sherotze bemishmuyshan.
Amar rav acha bereh derava: bekulecha, umishshum yad, umay "bemishmuyshan" – betashmishan.
Ta shema, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera zerua (asher yizzarea)", kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria – chitta biklippatah, useora biklippatah, vaadashim biklippatan.
Kidamar rav acha bereh derava, bekulecha, umishshum yad.
Hacha name, beshidra, umishshum shomer.
Bishlama illiyyata tzerichi letattayata, ella tetayyata may tzerichi leilliyyata? bechad dara.
Umi ikka kevetza ochalin bechad dara bechitte deshimon ben shatach?
Hasheta deatet lehachi, chada chitta name bechitte deshimon ben shatach.
Gufa: shene atzamot vaalehen shene chatzae zetim, vehichnis rashehen shenayim levayit, vehabbayit maahil alehen – habbayit tame.
Yehuda ben nakosa omer mishshum rabbi yaakov: heach shene atzamot mitztarfin lichzayit?
Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella etzem, dehave yad, aval nima la havya yad. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu nima name havya yad.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar, hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu, uvisara shekkenegdo – tame. may lav, mishshum yad?
La, mishshum shomer. umi ikka shomer al gabbe shomer? chalchule mechalchel.
Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: ella meatta, tefillin hechi katvinan? ha baenan ketiva tamma, velekka!
Ishtemitteh ha deamri bemareva: kol nekev shehaddeyo over alav – eno nekev.
Veibbaet ema, kulleh mishshum yad, kidamar rabbi ila: bimlay shebben hammelaim.
Hachi name, benima shebben hannimin.
Vehecha ittemar derabbi ila? aha: melay shebbashshibbolim mittammein umetammein, veenan mitztarfin. melay lemay chaze? amar rabbi ilay: bimlay shebben hammelaim.
Lishshana acharina amri la.
Hachi name mistabbera, demishshum shomer, dei salka datach mishshum yad – nima achat lemay chaze?
Kidamar rabbi ila: bimlay shebben hammelain, hacha name – benima shebben hannimin.
Vehecha ittemar derabbi ilay? aha ditnan: hammelay shebbashshibbolim mittammein umetammein veen mitztarfin. melay lemay chaze? amar rabbi ilay: bimlay shebben hammelaim.
Veikka dematne la

a: Ammatnitin: "haor veharotev vehakkefe vechulei" mitztarfin letamme tumeat ochalin.
Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella etzem, dehave shomer, aval nima la havya shomer. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu nima name havya shomer.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: umi ikka shomer al gabbe shomer? chalchule mechalchel.
Matkef la rav acha: ella meatta, tefillin hechi katvinan? ha baenan ketiva tamma, velekka!
Ishtemitteh ha deamri bemareva: kol nekev shehaddeyo over alav – eno nekev.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar, hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu, uvesaara shekkenegdo – tame. may lav mishshum shomer? la, mishshum yad.
Nima achat lemay chazya? kidamar rabbi ila: bimlay shebben hammelain, hachi name benima shebben hannimin.
Vehecha ittemar derabbi ila? aha ditnan: hammelay shebbashshibbolin metammein umittammein veen mitztarfin. melay lemay chaze? amar rabbi ila: bimlay shebben hammelain.
Veharotev. may rotev? amar rava: shumena.
Amar leh abbaye: hu atzmo yetamme tumeat ochalin! ella chelev dikrish.
May irya kerish? ki la kerish name! deamar resh lakish: tzir sheal gabbe yarak mitztaref lichchotevet beyom hakkippurim.
Hatam mishshum yattove data hu, bechol dehu meyatteva dateh.
Hacha mishshum itzterofe hu, i kerish – mitztaref, i la kerish – la mitztaref.
Vehakkefe, may kefe? amar rabba: pirma.
Amar leh abbaye: hu atzmo yetamme tumeat ochalin! ella amar rav pappa: tavlin.
Tenan hatam: hikpa et haddam vaachalo, o shehimcha et hachelev ugemao – chayyayv.
Bishlama hikpa et haddam vaachalo, kevan deakpeye achshove achsheveh, ella himcha et hachelev ugemao – achila ketiva beh, veha lav achila hi!
Amar resh lakish: amar kera "nefesh" – lerabbot et hashshote.
Tanya name gabbe chametz kehay gavna: himchahu ugemao – im chametz hu, anush karet; im matztza hi, en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach.
Bishlama im matztza hi en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach, "lechem oni" amar rachamana, vehay lav lechem oni hu. ella im chametz hu anush karet, achila ketiva beh!
Amar resh lakish: amar kera "nefesh" – lerabbot et hashshote.
Vetanya name gabbe nivlat of tahor kehay gavna: himchahu baur – tame, bachamma – tahor. vehavenan ba: achila ketiv beh!
Amar resh lakish: amar kera "nefesh" – lerabbot et hashshote. i hachi, bachamma name? bachamma aysroche masrach.
Utzerichi, dei ketav rachamana chelev – chametz la ate minneh, shekken lo hayta lo sheat hakkosher; nevela la ate minneh, shekken anush karet.
Vei ketav rachamana chametz – chelev la ate minneh, shekken lo huttar mikkelalo, unevela la atya minneh, shekken anush karet.
Vei ketav rachamana binvela – hanach la atya minna, shekken metammea.
Chada mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte! he tete? la lichtov rachamana binvela vetete mehanach – ma lehanach shekken anush karet!
La lichtov rachamana bechametz, vetete mehanach – ma lehanach, shekken lo hayta lahen sheat hakkosher!
La lichtov rachamana bechelev, vetete mehanach – ma lehanach shekken lo huttar mikkelalan, tomar bechelev shehuttar mikkelalo!
Umay nihu? illema chelev behema laggavoah – nevela name ishteray melikat of laggavoah.
Veella chelev chayya lehedyot – nevela name ishteray melika dechattat haof lakkohanim!
Leolam chelev chayya lehedyot, udeka kashya lach kohanim – kohanim mishshulchan gavoah ka zachu.
Veha detanya: "hattemeim" – leesor tziran verotvan vekefe shellahen, lema li? ligmar mehane!
Tzerichi, dei la ketav rachamana – hava amena: dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma hatam – ad deikka kezayit, af hacha name – ad deikka kezayit.
b: Velichtov rachamana bishratzim, veleto hanach veligmeru minnayyhu!
Mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lishratzim, shekken tumeatan bemashshehu.
Veha detanya: hattevel, vehechadash, vehahekdesh, vehashsheviit, vehakkilayim – kullan mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan. menalan?
Vechi tema: ligmar mehanach? ma lehanach – shekken issur habba meelav havu.
Tinach hecha deissur ba meelav, hecha delav issur habba meelav – menalan?
Gamrinan mibbikkurim, uvikkurim gufayyhu menalan?
Detane rabbi yose: "peri" – peri atta mevi, vei atta mevi mashke. hevi anavim uderachan – minnayin? talmud lomar: "tavi".
Ikka lemifrach: ma levikkurim shekken teunin keriyyay vehannacha!
Ella gamar mitteruma.
Uteruma gufa menalan? deittakkash levikkurim, deamar mar: "uterumat yadecha" – ellu bikkurim.
Ma litruma, shekken chayyayvin aleha mita vachomesh?
Ella, gamar mittarvayyhu, mitteruma uvikkurim – ma litruma uvikkurim, shekken chayyayvin alehem mita vachomesh!
Ella, atya mitteruma vechad mehanach, o mibbikkurim vechad mehanach.
Veha ditnan: devash temarim, veyen tappuchim, vechometz sitvavniyyot, ushear mine ferot shel teruma – rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Bemay peligi? bedun minna uminna, uvedun minna veoke beatra kamippalgi.

Derabbi eliezer savar: dun minna uminna, ma bikkurim – mashkin hayyotze mehen kemotan, af teruma name – mashkin hayyotze mehen kemotan, uminna – ma bikkurim afillu shear minin, af teruma name afillu shear minin.

Verabbi yehoshua savar, dun minna: ma bikkurim – mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan, af teruma – mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan. veoke beatra: ma mashkin dekadashim bitruma, tirosh veyitzhar – in, midde acharina – la, af mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemotan, tirosh veyitzhar – in, midde acharina – la.
Veha ditnan: en meviin bikkurim mashke ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim – manni?
Rabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: dun minna veoke veatra, vegamar lehu levikkurim mitteruma.
Veha ditnan: en sofgin et haarbaim mishshum orla, ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim – manni?
Rabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: dun minna veoke beatra, vegamar lehu levikkurim mitteruma,

a: Vahadar mayyte la leorla "peri" "peri" mibbikkurim.
Vehaalal. may alal? rabbi yochanan amar: marteka, veresh lakish amar: basar sheppelatattu sakkin.
Metivi: "veulam attem tofle shaker rofe elil kullechem". bishlama leman deamar marteka – hayeynu delav bar refua hu, ella leman deamar basar sheppelatattu sakkin – bar refua hu!
Baalal dikra, dechulle alma la feligi; ki peligi – baalal dematnitin.
Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: haalal hamechunnas, im yesh kezayit bemakom echad – chayyayvin alav, veamar rav huna: vehu shekkinneso.
Bishlama leman deamar basar sheppelatattu sakkin, hayeynu dechi ikka kezayit michayyayv, ella leman deamar marteka, ki ikka kezayit may have? etz bealma hu!
Allibba derabbi yehuda la peligi, ki peligi allibba derabbanan: rabbi yochanan amar: marteka name mitztaref, veresh lakish amar: davka basar sheppelatattu sakkin, aval marteka la mitztaref.
Hay basar sheppelatattu sakkin, hechi dame? i dechashshev aleh – afillu beanpe nafsheh mittamme, vei dela chashshev aleh – battole batteleh!
Rabbi avin verabbi meyaysha, chad amar: miktzato chishshev alav.
Vechad amar: miktzato pelatattu chayya, umiktzato pelatattu sakkin.
Tenan hatam: hachartom vehatztzippornayim mittammein umetammein umitztarfin. chartom – etz bealma hu!
Amar rabbi elazar: bechartom tachton. tachton name etz bealma hu! amar rav pappa: tachton shel elyon.
Tzippornayim, amar rabbi elazar: makom (hamevabelaaym) [hammuvela] babbasar.
Karnayim, amar rav pappa: bimkom shechotchin veyotze mehen dam.
Keyotze bo, hashshochet behema.
Amar rabbi assi: shonin yisrael bitmea, vegoy bithora – tzerichin machshava vehechsher mayim mimmakom acher.
Hechsher lema li? sofo letamme tumea chamura, vechol shessofo letamme tumea chamura – la bae hechsher.
Detane deve rabbi yishmael: "vechi yuttan mayim al zera", ma zeraim sheen sofan letamme tumea chamura tzerichin hechsher, af kol sheen sofo letamme tumea chamura tzarich hechsher.
Vetanya, amar rabbi yose: mippene ma amru nivlat of tahor tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher? mippene
b: Shessofah letamme tumea chamura!
Amar chizkiyya: hoil veyachol legorrah, ulehaamidah al pachot mikkezayit.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: umi amar chizkiyya hachi? veha ittemar: shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim, vaadayin hi mefarkeset – chizkiyya amar: enah leevarim, rabbi yochanan amar: yeshnah leevarim.
Chizkiyya amar enah leevarim: meta hi. rabbi yochanan amar yeshnah leevarim: lav meta hi.
Amar leh: yatzta mikkelal chayya, velichlal meta lo bat.

Gufa: shachat bah shenayim, o rov shenayim, vaadayin hi mefarkeset – chizkiyya amar: enah leevarim, rabbi yochanan amar: yeshnah leevarim. amar rabbi elazar: nekot leha derabbi yochanan beyadcha, detane rav oshaya kevavteh.
Detane rav oshaya: yisrael sheshshachat behema temea legoy, shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim, umefarkeset – metammea tumeat ochalin, aval lo tumeat nevelot.
Ever happoresh mimmenna, keforesh min hachay, uvasar happoresh mimmenna, kevasar happoresh min hachay, veasur livne noach, vaafillu leachar shettetze nafshah.
Shachat bah echad, o rov echad – enah metammea tumeat ochalin; necharah – en bah tumea shel kelum.
Vegoy sheshshachat behema tehora leyisrael, umefarkeset – metammea tumeat ochalin, aval lo tumeat nevela.
Ever happoresh mimmenna, keforesh min hachay, uvasar happoresh mimmenna, keforesh min hachay, veasur livne noach, vaafillu leachar shettetze nafshah.
Shachat bah echad o rov echad – enah metammea tumeat ochalin, necharah – en bah tumea shel kelum.
Shachat goy bimkom sheen ose otah terefa, uva yisrael ugemarah – keshera.
Shachat yisrael, ben bimkom sheose otah terefa, uven bimkom sheen ose otah terefa, uva goy vegamar shechitato – pesula.

Harotze sheyyochal mibbehema kodem shettetze nafshah, chotech kezayit basar mibbet shechitatah, umolcho yafe yafe, umedicho yafe yafe, umamtin la ad shettetze nafshah, veochlo. echad goy veechad yisrael muttarin bo.

Mesayyay leh lerav idi bar avin, deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyayn: harotze sheyyavri, chotech kezayit basar mibbet shechita, umolcho yafe yafe, umedicho yafe yafe, umamtin lah ad shettetze nafshah, echad goy veechad yisrael muttarim bo.
Bae rabbi elazar: shaha bah, daras bah – mahu?
Amar leh hahu sava: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: tzericha hechsher shechita kivhema tehora. hechsher lemay? amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: bedikat sakkin.
Bea minneh rabbi zera merav sheshet: mahu shettatztzil al habbeluin shebbetochah?
Amar leh metammea tumeat ochalin, umatztzelet? amar leh: enah metammea tumeat nevelot, velo tatztzil?
Amar abbaye: enah matztzelet al habbeluim shebbetochah, deha metammea tumeat ochalin, veharovah chayyayv, deha enah metammea tumeat nevela.
Rabbi yehuda omer: haalal [vechulei]. amar rav huna: vehu shekkinneso.
Veamar rav huna: shene chatzae zetim sheyyeshnan al gabbe haor – haor mevattelan,

a: Allibba deman?
I allibba derabbi yishmael – haamar lo mevattel or. vei allibba derabbi akiva – peshita, haamar mevattel or.
Leolam allibba derabbi yishmael, vechi amar rabbi yishmael lo mevattel or – hane mille sheppelatattu chaya, aval pelatattu sakkin – batel.
Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: haalal hamechunnas, im yesh kezayit bemakom echad – chayyayvin alav, veamar rav huna: vehu shekkinneso.
I amrat bishlama pelatattu sakkin, lerabbi yishmael name la batel, rav huna deamar kerabbi yishmael.
Ella i amrat pelatattu sakkin, lerabbi yishmael batel, rav huna deamar keman?
Ella leolam pelatattu sakkin, lerabbi yishmael lo batel, verav huna deamar kerabbi akiva!
Peshita! mahu detema, ki kaamar rabbi akiva – hane mille pelatattu sakkin, aval pelatattu chayya – la batel.

Ka mashma lan tama derabbi akiva mippene shehaor mevattelan, la shena (palet) [pelatattu] chayya, vela shena (palet) [pelatattu] sakkin, kidkatane sefa: mippene ma rabbi akiva metaher beor? mippene shehaor mevattelan.
Mishna ellu sheorotehen kivsaran: or haadam, vaor chazir shel yishshuv. rabbi yehuda omer: af or chazir habbar.

Vaor chateret shel gamal harakka, veor harosh shel egel harach, vaor happerasot, veor bet habboshet, vaor hashshelil, veor shel tachat haalya, vaor haanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet. rabbi yehuda omer: halletaa kechuleda.
Vechullan sheibbedan, o shehillech bahen kede avoda – tehorin, chutz meor haadam. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot.
Gemara amar ulla: devar tora or adam tahor, uma taam amru tame? gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin.

Veikka dematne la assefa, vechullan sheibbedan o shehillech bahen kede avoda tehorin, chutz meor adam. amar ulla: devar tora or adam sheibbedo tahor, uma taam amru tame? gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin.
Man dematne la aresha, kol shekken assefa, uman dematne assefa, aval aresha – tumea deorayyta.
Veor chazir [vechulei]. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: hay ashshun vehay rakkich, umar savar: hay name rakkich.
Or chateret shel gamal harakka, vechamma gamal harakka? amar ulla, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol zeman shello taana.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: higgia zemannah liton velo taana, mahu? bae abbaye: lo higgia zemannah liton vetaana, mahu? teku.
Yatev resh lakish vekamibbaya leh: kamma gamal harakka? amar leh rabbi yishmael bar abba: hachi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol zeman shello taana. amar leh: tiv lekivli.

Yatev rabbi zera vekamibbaya leh: kamma gamal harakka? amar leh ravin bar chinnana: hachi amar ulla, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol zeman shello taana. hava katane la. amar leh: chada havya lach amart.
Ta chazi, ma ben takkife ara deyisrael, lachaside devavel.
Veor harosh vechulei. vechamma egel harach? ulla amar: ben shenato, rabbi yochanan amar: kol zeman sheyyonek. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar ulla? ben shenato vehu sheyyonek,
b: Vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: kol zeman sheyyonek.
O dilma, ulla ben shenato kaamar, ben yonek uven sheeno yonek, vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: ben shenato vehu sheyyonek?
Ta shema, rabbi yochanan amar: kol zeman sheyyonek, veim ita – "vehu sheyyonek" mibbee leh! shema minna.
Bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: or harosh shel egel harach, mahu sheyyetamme? amar leh: eno metamme.
Amar leh, limmadtanu rabbenu: ellu sheorotehen kivsaran, veor harosh shel egel harach! amar leh: al takniteni, bilshon yachid ani shone otah.
Detanya: hashshochet et haola lehaketir kezayit meor shettachat haalya, chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet; chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.

Elazar ben yehuda ish evlayim omer mishshum rabbi yaakov, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar ikkum omer mishshum rabbi shimon: echad or perasot, veechad or harosh shel egel harach, veechad or shel tachat haalya, vechol shemmanu chachamim gabbe tumea sheorotehen kivsaran, lehavi or shel bet habboshet.
Chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Veor bet happerasot. may bet happerasot? rav amar: bet happerasot mammash, rabbi chanina amar: rechubba hannimkeret im harosh.
Vaor haanaka, tanu rabbanan: "hattemeim" – lerabbot orotehen kivsaran.
Yachol afillu kullan, talmud lomar "elle".
Veha "elle" akkullehu ketivi! amar rav: "leminehu" hifsik hainyan.
Velichshov name tinshemet? amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: rav tena hu, vetane tinshemet.
Veha tanna didan la tane tinshemet?
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: tanna didan savar la kerabbi yehuda, deazel batar gishta.
Uvegishta dehalletaa kamippalgi.
Vechullan sheibbedan [vechulei]. hillech in, lo hillech la? veha tane rabbi chiyyay: ozen chamor shettelaah lekuppato tehora, telaah – af al gav dela hillech!
Lo: telaah, hillech – in, lo hillech – la.
Kamma kede ibbud? amar rav huna amar rabbi yannay: arbaat milin.
Rabbi avahu mishshum deresh lakish amar: legabbal.
Velitfilla velintilat yadayim – arbaat milin.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak:

a: Ayvu amra, vearbee amar ba, vachada minnayyhu avoda.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lo shanu ella lefanav, aval leacharav – afillu mil echad eno chozer. rav acha bar yaakov amar, uminna: mil hu deeno chozer, ha pachot mimmil – chozer.

Tanu rabbanan: ligyon haover mimmakom lemakom, venichnas levayit – habbayit tame, sheen lach kol ligyon veligyon sheen lo kamma karkiflin. veal titma, shehare karkiflo shel rabbi yishmael munnach berosh melachim.
Mishna hammafshit babbehema uvachayya, battehora uvattemea, baddakka uvaggassa –
Leshatiach, kede achiza.
Ulechemet – ad sheyyafshit et hechaze.
Hammargil – kullo chibbur lattumea, littamme uletamme. or sheal hatztzavvar – rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: eno chibbur, vachachamim omrim: chibbur ad sheyyafshit et kullo.
Gemara mikkan veelach may?
Amar rav: tahor hammufeshat, rabbi assi amar: tefach hassamuch labbasar tame.
Metivi: hammafshit keshiur hazze, mikkan veelach, hannogea bammufeshat tahor. may lav afillu betefach hassamuch labbasar? la, levar mittefach hassamuch labbasar.
Ta shema: beor shekkeneged habbasar – tame. or shekkeneged habbasar – tame, ha betefach hassamuch labbasar – tahor. tana: kol tefach hassamuch labbasar, or shekkeneged habbasar kare leh.
Ta shema: hammafshit babbehema uvachayya, battehora uvattemea, baddakka uvaggassa, leshatiach – kede achiza, vetefach hassamuch labbasar – tahor.
Hacha bemay askinan? betefach rishon.
Tana: kamma kede achiza? tefach. veha tanya: tifchayim!
Amar abbaye: tefach kaful. tanya name hachi: kamma kede achiza? tefach kaful.
Tenan hatam: tallit shehitchil bah lekorah, kevan shennikra rubbah – shuv eno chibbur, utehora.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella betallit tevulat yom.
Demiggo dela chas ala veatbela, la chayes ala vekara la rubba. aval tallit sheenah tevulat yom – la, gezera dilma la ate lemikrea rubba.
Amar rabba: shete teshuvot baddavar: chada – shemma yomru tevila bat yoma ola, veod –
b: Olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ligzar, dilma la ate lemebad rov shenayim.
Amar leh rav yosef: deka amrat gezera shemma yomru tevila bat yoma ola – kirah mochiach aleha.
Udeka amrat, olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon ligzar – kohanim zerizim hen.
Ta shema: hammafshit babbehema uvachayya, battemea uvithora, baddakka uvaggassa, leshatiach – kede achiza.
Ha yater mikkede achiza – tahor, ammay? ligzar, dilma la ate lemebad ella kede achiza, veka nega betumea, veka metaharinan leh!
I betumea deorayyta – hachi name, hacha bemay askinan? betumea derabbanan.
Tinach tame battehora, tahor bitmea – tumea deorayyta hi! bitrefa.
Terefa bat tammoye hi? in, kedaavu dishmuel, deamar avu dishmuel: terefa sheshshechatah metammea bemukedashin.
Ta shema: rabbi dostay ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer: hammafshit bishratzim – chibbur, ad sheyyafshit et kullo.
Ha begamal – eno chibbur.
La tema ha begamal eno chibbur, ella ema: beor sheal hatztzavvar eno chibbur, verabbi yochanan ben nuri hi.
Amar rav huna mishshum rabbi shimon berabbi yose: lo shanu ella shello shiyyer bah kede maporet, aval shiyyer bah kede maporet – chibbur.
Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella tallit, aval or – chalim. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu or name la chalim.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: or tame midras, chishshev alav lirtzuot vesandalim – kevan shennatan bo izmel tahor, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyamitennu mechamishsha tefachim. ki memaet leh miha tahor, ammay? lema chalim!
Ki kaamri dachalim, hecha deka tzare leh lehedya, hacha bemay askinan – bimkatztzea uva lo derech sevivotav.

Metiv rabbi yirmeya: hammafshit babbehema uvachayya, battehora uvattemea, baddakka uvaggassa, leshatiach kede achiza – ha yater mikkede achiza tahor, veammay? lema chalim! targema rabbi avin: rishon rishon ose nippul.
Metiv rav yosef: or sheal hatztzavvar, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer eno chibbur. ammay? ha chalim vekae!
Amar leh abbaye: ema sefa, vachachamim omrim: chibbur.
Ella amar abbaye: beshomer heasuy linnatek meelav ka mippalgi, mar savar: have shomer, umar savar: la have shomer.
Metiv rabbi yirmeya: tannur shennitma ketzad metaharin oto? cholko lishlosha, vegorer et hattefela

a: Ad sheyyehe baaretz. rabbi meir omer: eno tzarich lo ligror et hattefela velo ad sheyyehe baaretz, ella memaato mibbifnim (mearba) [mearbaa] tefachim.
Ki memaet la (mearba) [mearbaa] miha tahor, ammay? lema: ha chalim vekae!
Amar leh rava: veema midderabbanan – gorer et hattefela ad sheyyehe baaretz.
Ella amar rava: hachi kaamar, tannur shennitma ketzad metaharin oto? divre hakkol cholko lishlosha, vegorer et hattefela ad sheyyehe baaretz.

Veharotze shello yavo tannuro lide tumea, ketzad hu ose? cholko lishlosha, vegorer et hattefela ad sheyyehe baaretz. rabbi meir omer: eno tzarich lo ligror et hattefela velo ad sheyyehe baaretz, ella memaato mibbifnim mearbaa tefachim.
Amar mar: cholko lishlosha.
Ureminhu: tannur, techillato arbaa, usheyarav arbaa, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: bamme devarim amurim begadol, aval bekatan – techillato kol shehu, mishshettiggamer melachto – sheyarav berubbo.
Vechamma "kol shehu"? amri deve rabbi yannay: tefach, shekken osim (tannurim) [tannure] banot tefach.
Tama deikka sheyarav arba, ha lekka sheyarav arba – tahor.
Amri: hatam, detzalkeh mitzlak; hacha, deavdeh gistera.
Amar mar: sheyarav berubbo, rubbo detefach lemay have?
Amar abbaye: sheyare gadol berubbo, vehaamri rabbanan arbaa? la kashya: ha betannura bar tisha, ha betannura bar shiva.
Lishshana acharina amri la: amar rav huna mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: vaafillu shiyyer bah kede maporet.
Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella tallit, aval or – chashiv, verabbi yochanan amar: afillu or name la chashiv.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: or tame midras, chishshev alav lirtzua vesandalin – kevan shennatan bo izmel tahor, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyamitennu mechamishsha tefachim.
Ki memaet miha tahor, ammay? lema chashiv! hacha bemay askinan – deka vae leh lemoshav zav.
Mishna or sheyyesh alav kezayit basar, hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu, uvesaara shekkenegdo – tame.

Hayu alav kishne chatzae zetim, metamme bemassa velo bemagga, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lo bemagga velo bemassa. umode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan, shehu tame. umippene ma rabbi akiva metaher baor? mippene shehaor mevattelan.
Gemara amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella pelatattu chayya, aval pelatattu sakkin – batel.
Amar leh rav nachman leulla: amar rabbi yochanan afillu ketarta? amar leh: in. vaafillu kenafya? amar leh: in. amar leh: haelohim! im amar li rabbi yochanan mippummeh – la tzayetna leh.

Ki selek rav oshaya, ashkecheh leh lerabbi amme, amra lishmatay kammeh: hachi amar ulla, vehachi ahdar leh rav nachman. amar leh: umishshum derav nachman chatneh deve nesia hu, mezalzel bishmateh derabbi yochanan?!
Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar la assefa: hayu alav shene chatzae zetim – metammeim bemassa velo bemagga, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lo bemagga velo bemassa.
Amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella pelatattu chayya, aval pelatattu sakkin – batel.
Amar leh mar assefa matne la? amar leh: in. veella ulla aresha amra nihalaychu? amar leh: in. amar leh: haelohim, i amar li yehoshua bin nun mishshemeh – la tzayetna leh!
Ki ata ravin vechol nachote, amruha aresha. veella kashya? kidamar rav pappa:
b: Bimruddad, hacha name bimruddad.
Hayu alav.
Amar bar peda: lo shanu ella meacharav, aval millefanav – yesh nogea vechozer venogea.
Verabbi yochanan amar: en nogea vechozer venogea, veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yishmael verabbi dosa ben harekinas amru davar echad.
Rabbi yishmael – ha daamaran; rabbi dosa ben harekinas – ditnan: kol hametammein beohel, shennechleku vehichnisan letoch habbayit – rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammeim.
Lav amar rabbi dosa ben harekinas hatam, en maahil vechozer umaahil, hacha name en nogea vechozer venogea.
Umidderabbi dosa ben harekinas kerabbi yishmael, rabbanan kerabbi akiva? veha rabbi akiva tahore ka metahar!

Ad kan la ka metahar rabbi akiva ella beor, aval bealma metamme, kidkatane sefa: umode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan shehu tame. umippene ma rabbi akiva metaher baor? mippene shehaor mevattelan.
Metiv rav ukeva bar chama: "benivlatam" – velo beor sheyyesh alav shene chatzae zetim.

Yachol af bemassa? talmud lomar "vehannose yitma" – divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: "hannogea" "vehannose" – et shebba lichlal magga, ba lichlal massa; lo ba lichlal magga, lo ba lichlal massa.
Veim ita, hare ba lichlal magga millefanav?
Amar rava: hachi kaamar, et shebba lichlal magga bechol tzad – ba lichlal massa, lo ba lichlal magga bechol tzad – lo ba lichlal massa.
Bea minneh rav avya sava merabba bar rav huna: kulit setuma, lerabbi yishmael, mahu shettetamme?
It leh lerabbi yishmael: et shebba lichlal magga – ba lichlal massa, lo ba lichlal magga – lo ba lichlal massa, vehacha hayeynu tama mishshum deva lichlal magga millefanav.
O dilma let leh?
Amar leh: orva parach.
Amar leh rava bereh: velav hayeynu rav avya sava mippumebdita, dimshabbach lan mar begavveh degavra rabba hu? amar leh: ani hayyom "sammechuni baashishot", uvea minnay milleta devae tama.
Amar ulla: shene chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam, afillu molich umevi kol hayyom kullo – tahor.
May tama? ketiv "venissa" vekarenan "nose", baenan "nose" vehu denissa bevat achat.
Tenan: hayu alav shene chatzae zetim – metammein bemassa velo bemagga, divre rabbi yishmael. ammay? veha lav nissa hu!
Amar rav pappa: bimruddad.
Ta shema: mode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan shehu tame. ammay? veha lav nissa hu! hachi name bimruddad.
Ketannae: echad hannogea veechad hammesit, rabbi eliezer omer: af hannose. attu nose lav mesit hu?
Ella lav hachi kaamar: echad hannogea veechad hammesit belo nissa, vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: vehu denissa, umay "af"? ema: vehu denissa.
Mishna kulit hammet

a: Vekulit hammukedashin, hannogea bahen, ben setumim ben nekuvim – tame.

Kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz, hannogea bahem setumim – tehorim, nekuvim kol shehu – metamme bemagga. minnayin sheaf bemassa? talmud lomar "hannogea … vehannose", et shebba lichlal magga – ba lichlal massa, lo ba lichlal magga – lo ba lichlal massa.
Gemara nogea – in, aval maahil – la.
Hechi dame? i deikka kezayit basar – beohel name litamme! delekka kezayit basar.
Vei deikka kezayit moach mibbifnim – tumea bokaat veola, beohel name litamme! delekka kezayit moach bifnim.
Vei moach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz, ever mealleya hi, beohel name litamme! amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: zot omeret, moach bifnim eno maale arucha mibbachutz.
Bemay okemta? delekka kezayit. i hachi, bemukedashim ammay metamme?
Vetu, kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz ki nikkevu, ammay metammeu?
Ha la kashya, resha delekka kezayit, sefa deikka kezayit. umay ka mashma lan? mille mille ka mashma lan.

Resha ka mashma lan demoach mibbifnim eno maale arucha mibbachutz. mukedashin may ka mashma lan? shimmush notar milleta hi, deamar mari bar avu amar rabbi yitzchak: atzmot kadashim sheshshimmeshu notar, metammein et hayyadayim, hoil venaasa basis ledavar haasur.
Nevela, af al gav deikka kezayit, nikkeva – in, lo nikkeva – la.
Abbaye amar: leolam moach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz, vehacha bemay askinan – besheshshippah.
Vechidrabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: kulit sheshshippah leorkah – temea, lerochbah – tehora, vesimanaych – dikla.
Verabbi yochanan amar: leolam deikka kezayit, umoach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz, umay nogea dekatane – maahil.
Vei moach mibbifnim maale arucha mibbachutz, kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz ki lo nikkevu, ammay tehorim?

Amar rabbi binyamin bar giddel, amar rabbi yochanan: hacha bemay askinan, kegon deikka kezayit moach hammitkashkesh, gabbe met – tumea bokaat veola, nevela – kevan demitkashkesh hu, nikkeva – in, lo nikkeva – la.
Amar rabbi avin, veittema rabbi yose bar avin: af anan name tenena – hannogea bechachatzi zayit, umaahil al chatzi zayit, o chatzi zayit maahil alav – tame.
I amrat bishlama chad shema hu – mishshum hachi mitztaref.
Ella i amrat tere sheme ninhu – mi mitztaref? vehatnan: ze hakkelal, kol shehu mishshem echad – mitztaref vetame, mishshene shemot – tahor!
Ella may chad shema hu? ema sefa: aval
b: Hannogea bechachatzi zayit, vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit – tahor.
Vei chad shema hu, ammay tahor? ella, kashya resha.
Amar rabbi zera: betumea retzutza ben shene migdalim askinan, veen benehen poteach tefach, dechulla negia hi.
Uman tanna dekare leohel "nogea"? rabbi yose hi, detanya: rabbi yose omer: melo tarvavd rakav metamme bemagga, uvemassa, uveohel.
Bishlama bemassa uveohel, ha ka taen leh lechulleh, veha ka maahel akkulleh. ella nogea – ha la naga bechulleh! ella lav shema minna: may "nogea" – maahil.
Veha katane "nogea", veha katane "maahil"! amar abbaye: lematta mittefach – ohel negia, lemala mittefach – ohel gereda.
Rava amar: afillu lemala mittefach name ohel negia hu, vehechi dame ohel gereda? behameshacha.
Amar rava: mena amena la? ditnan, rabbi yose omer: chavile mitta userige challonot chotztzin ben habbayit laaliyyay, shello lehachenis tumea letzad sheni.
Perasan al pene hammet baavir, hannogea keneged hannekev – tame, shello keneged hannekev – tahor.
Hechi dame? illema lematta mittefach, shello keneged hannekev – ammay tahor? met bichsuto hi, umet bichsuto metamme!
Ella lav lemala mittefach, veka kare leh "nogea".
Amar abbaye: leolam lematta mittefach, udekaamrat: met bichsuto hu – met bichsuto mevattel leh, hay la mevattel leh.
Veteheve ketumea temuna bokaat veola? kasavar rabbi yose: tumea temuna enah bokaat.
Umena temra? ditnan: tevat hammigdal sheyyesh bah poteach tefach veen bitziatah poteach tefach, tumea betochah – habbayit tame; tumea babbayit – ma shebbetochah tahor.
Mippene shedderech tumea latzet, veen derech tumea likkanes.
Verabbi yose metaher, mippene sheyyachol hu lehotziah lachatzain, o lesorfah bimkomah.
Vekatane sefa: heemidah bappetach, ufitchah lachutz – tumea betochah, habbayit tahor; tumea babbayit, ma shebbetochah tahor.

a: Vetane ala: rabbi yose metaher. aheyay? illema assefa – tanna kamma name tahore ka metahar!

Ella, dekaamar tanna kamma: tumea betochah – habbayit tame, i mishshum dederech tumea latzet, vei mishshum detumea temuna bokaat. vekaamar leh rabbi yose: udekaamrat derech tumea latzet – yachol hu lehotziah lachatzain o lesorfah bimkomah, udekaamrat tumea temuna bokaat – tumea temuna enah bokaat.
Verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose.
Ditnan: hakkelev sheachal basar met, umet hakkelev, umuttal al haiskuppa – rabbi meir omer: im yesh betzavvaro poteach tefach – mevi et hattumea, veim lav – eno mevi et hattumea.
Rabbi yose omer: roin mikkeneged hashshakof velifnim – habbayit tame, mikkeneged hashshekof velachutz – habbayit tahor.
Rabbi elazar omer: piv lifnim habbayit – tahor, piv lachutz habbayit – tame, mippene shettumea yotza derech shulav.
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame.
May lav, aen betzavvaro poteach tefach kae rabbi yose?
Ushema minna: tumea temuna bokaat!
Amar rava: roin et chalal hattumea katane, verabbi yose betarte pelig, vekaamar leh lerabbi meir: dekaamrat ki yesh betzavvaro poteach tefach mevi et hattumea – anan batar chalala azlinan.
Udeka amrat habbayit kullo tame – mikkeneged hashshekof velifnim habbayit tame, mikkeneged hashshekof velachutz habbayit tahor.
Rav acha bereh derava matne la behedya: rabbi yose omer: roin et chalal hattumea.
Uman tanna diflig aleh? rabbi shimon hu, detanya: rabbi shimon omer:
b: Shalosh tumeot porshot min hammet, shetayim bechol achat ushelishit en bahen, veellu hen: melo tarvavd rakav, veetzem kisora, vegolel vedofek.
Melo tarvavd rakav – metamme bemassa uveohel, veeno metamme bemagga, vehechan maggao? im achat mehen.
Etzem kisora – metamme bemassa uvemagga, veeno metamme beohel, vehechan oholo? im achat mehen.
Haggolel vedofek – metamme bemagga uveohel, veeno metamme bemassa, vehechan massao? im echad mehen.
Kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "benivlatah" – velo bekulit setuma.
Yachol afillu nikkeva? talmud lomar "hannogea … yitma", et sheefshar ligga – tame, veet shei efshar ligga – tahor.
Amar leh rabbi zera leabbaye: ella meatta, behema beorah lo tetamme? pok chazi kamma nekavim yesh bah!
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: ella meatta, kuleya bechelbah lo tetamme? ta chazi kamma chutin nimshachin hemenna.
Bae rav oshaya: chishshev aleha lenokvah velo nikkeva, mahu? mechussar nekiva kimchussar maase dame, o la?
Hadar pashta: mechussar nekiva lav kimchussar maase dame.

Mishna betzat hashsheretz hamerukkemet tehora, nikkeva kol shehu – tame. achbar shechetzyo basar vechetzyo adama – hannogea babbasar tame, baadama tahor. rabbi yehuda omer: af hannogea baadama shekkeneged habbasar tame.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "hattemeim" – lerabbot betzat hashsheretz vekulit hashsheretz.
Yachol afillu lo rikkema? talmud lomar "hashsheretz" – ma sheretz sherikkem, af betzat hashsheretz sherikkema.
Yachol afillu lo nikkevu? talmud lomar "hannogea … yitma", et sheefshar ligga – tame, veet shei efshar ligga – tahor.
Vechamma nekivatah? kechut hassaara, sheefshar ligga kechut hassaara.

Achbar shechetzyo [vechulei]. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: vehu shehishritz al pene kullo. ikka dematne la assefa – rabbi yehuda omer: af hannogea baadama shekkeneged basar tame, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: vehu shehishritz al pene kullo.
Man dematne la aresha, kol shekken assefa, uman dematne la assefa – aval resha, af al gav dela hishritz.

Tanu rabbanan: mittoch shenneemar "achbar", shomea ani afillu achbar shebbayyam, sheshshemo achbar. vedin hu: timme bechuleda vetimme beachbar, ma chuleda min haggadel al haaretz, af achbar min haggadel al haaretz.

O kelach lederech zo: timme bechuleda vetimme beachbar, ma chuleda kol sheshshemah "chuleda", af achbar kol sheshshemo "achbar", afillu achbar shebbayyam sheshshemo "achbar". talmud lomar "al haaretz".
I "al haaretz", yachol al haaretz – yetamme, yarad leyam – lo yetamme,

a: Talmud lomar "hashshoretz" – kol makom sheshshoretz.
O eno ella "hashshoretz" – yachol kol hammashritz yetamme, sheen mashritz lo yetamme? otzi achbar shechetzyo basar vechetzyo adama, sheen pare verave.
Vedin hu: timme bechuleda vetimme beachbar, ma chuleda – kol sheshshemah chuleda, af achbar – kol sheshshemo achbar, avi achbar shechetzyo basar vechetzyo adama.
O kelach lederech zo: ma chuleda para verava, af achbar pare verave? talmud lomar "bashsheretz".

Amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerava: ema "bashsheretz", leetoye achbar shechetzyo basar vechetzyo adama, "hashshoretz" – kol shehu shoretz, vaafillu achbar shebbayyam, vei mishshum "al haaretz" – al haaretz yetamme, yarad layyam – lo yetamme.
Amar leh: umeachar deshavviteh leyam mekom tumea, ma li hacha, ma li hacha.
Vehay "al haaretz" mibbee leh lehotzi sefek tumea tzafa, deamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: "al haaretz" – lehotzi sefek tumea tzafa!
Tarte "al haaretz" ketivi.
Tanu rabbanan: "hatztzav leminehu" – lehavi hearod, vechen hannefilim vesalamandera.

Ucheshehaya rabbi akiva maggia lefasuk ze, omer: "ma rabbu maasecha Adonai"! yesh lecha beriyyot gedelot bayyam, veyesh lecha beriyyot gedelot bayyabbasha. shebbayyam – ilmale olot (bayyabbasha) [layyabbasha] miyyad metot, shebbayyabbasha – ilmale yordot layyam miyyad metot.
Yesh lecha beriyyot gedelot baur, veyesh lecha beriyyot gedelot baavir. shebbaur – ilmale olot laavir miyyad metot, shebbaavir – ilmale yordot laur miyyad metot. "ma rabbu maasecha Adonai".
Tanu rabbanan: kol sheyyesh bayyabbasha yesh bayyam, chutz min hachuleda. amar rabbi zera: may keraa? "haazinu kol yoshve chaled".
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: bivre denaresh enan min hayyishshuv.
Amar rav pappa: beshamta naresh, tarbeh mashkeh vealyeteh. "eretz eretz aretz shimi devar Adonai" – amar rav pappa: lo ava naresh shemoa devar Adonai.
Amar rav giddel, amar rav: narshaa nashshekaych – mane kakkaych; nehar pekodaa lavyaych – miggelima shappira dechaze alach; pumebditaa lavyaych – ashni ushepizach.
Amar rav huna bar torta: paam achat halachti lavvavad, veraiti nachash shehu karuch al hatztzav, leyamim yatza arvad mibbenehem.
Ucheshebbati lifne rabbi shimon hechasid, amar li: amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hem heviu beriyya shello barati beolami, af ani avi alehem beriyya shello barati beolami.
Vehaamar mar: kol shettashmishan veibburan shave – yoldin umegaddelin ze mizze, vechol sheen tashmishan veibburan shave – en yoldin umegaddelin ze mizze.
Amar rav: nes betoch nes! hay pureanuta hu? may nes betoch nes – lefureanut.
Mishna haever vehabbasar hameduledalin babbehema, metammein tumeat ochalin bimkoman, utzerichin hechsher.
b: Nishchata habbehema – hucheshru bedameha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer: lo hucheshru.
Meta habbehema – habbasar tzarich hechsher, haever metamme mishshum ever min hachay, veeno metamme mishshum ever nevela – divre rabbi meir, verabbi shimon metaher.
Gemara tumeat ochalin – in, tumeat nevela – la.
Hechi dame? i demaalin arucha – afillu tumeat ochalin name la littammu, vei deen maalin arucha – tumeat nevela name littammu!
Leolam, deen maalin arucha, veshane tumeat nevela, derachamana amar "ki yippol", ad sheyyippol.
Tanya name hachi: haever vehabbasar hameduledalin bivhema umeorin bechut hassaara, yachol yetammeu tumeat nevela? talmud lomar "yippol" – ad sheyyippol, vaafillu hachi tumeat ochalin metammu.
Mesayyay leh lerav chiyyay bar ashe, deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: teenim shetztzamku beibbehen – metammeot tumeat ochalin, vehattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyayv chattat.
Lema mesayyay leh: yerakot shetztzamku beibbehen, kegon hakkeruv vehaddallaat – en metammein tumeat ochalin; ketzatzan veyibbeshan – metammein tumeat ochalin.
Ketzatzan veyibbeshan, salka datach?! etz bealma hu! veamar rabbi yitzchak: beal menat leyabbeshan.
Tama dichruv vedallaat hu, kevan deyibbeshan lav bene achila ninhu, ha shear perot metammei.
Hechi dame? i deyibbeshan hen veuketzehen – peshita! ella lav – belo uketzehen.
Leolam hen veuketzehen, uketzatzan al menat leyabbeshan itztericha leh.
Ta shema: ilan shennifshach uvo perot – hare hen kitlushin, yavshu – hare hen kimchubbarin. may lav: ma telushin lechol divrehen, af mechubbarin lechol divrehen?
Midde irya? ha kidita, veha kidita.
Nishchata habbehema [vechulei]. bemay ka mippalgi?
Amar rabba: bivhema naaset yad leever kamippalgi: mar savar en behema naaset yad leever, umar savar behema naaset yad leever.
Abbaye amar: beochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo kamippalgi.
Mar savar: ochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo – hare hu kamohu, umar savar: eno kamohu.
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar, beochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo ka mippalgi.
Derabbi yochanan rame derabbi meir adderabbi meir: mi amar rabbi meir, ochez bekatan veen gadol ole immo hare hu kamohu?
Ureminhu: ochel shennifras umeore bemiktzat,

a: Rabbi meir omer: im ochez bakkatan vegadol ole immo – hare hu kamohu, veim lav – eno kamohu.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.
Umay kusheya? dilma shane leh lerabbi meir ben tevul yom lishar tumeot.
Tanya, rabbi omer: echad tevul yom veechad shear tumeot.
Vedilma, lerabbi la shane leh, ulerabbi meir shane leh?
Amar rabbi yoshiyya, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre rabbi muchelefet hashshita.
Rava amar: beyesh yad letumea, veen yad lehechsher, kamippalgi.
Mar savar yesh yad letumea veen yad lehechsher, umar savar yesh yad letumea ulehechsher.
Rav pappa amar: behechsher kodem machshava kamippalgi.
Ditnan, amar rabbi yehuda: kach haya rabbi akiva shone – chelev shechuta bakkefarim tzarich machshava, veen tzarich hechsher, shekkevar hucheshar bashshechita.
Amarti lefanav: limmadtanu rabbenu, uleshin shellikketan vehiddichan labbehema, venimlach alehen laadam – tzerichot hechsher sheni. vechazar rabbi akiva lihyot shone kerabbi yehuda.
Mar savar la kemeikkara, umar savar la kachazara.
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar: benitkanneach haddam ben siman lesiman kamippalgi.
Mar savar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof, vehay dam shechita hu, umar savar enah lishchita ella lesof, vehay dam makka hu.
Rav ashe amar: bishchita machsheret velo dam kamippalgi.
Bae rabba: behema bechayyeha, mahu shettease yad leever? teku.
Amar abbaye: hare amru, kishshut shennetaah beatzitz vehigdila veyatzat chutz leatzitz – tehora.
Amar rabbi shimon: vechi ma tivah letaher? ella hattame betumeato, vetahor betohorato.
Bae abbaye: mahu shettease yad lachavertah? teku.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hare amru hammishtachave lachatzi dallaat asarah, bae rabbi yirmeya:
b: Mahu shettease yad lachavertah? teku.
Amar rav pappa: hare amru yichur shel teena shennifshach umeore biklippatah – rabbi yehuda metaher, vachachamim omrim: im yachol lichyot – tahor, veim lav – tame.
Bae rav pappa: mahu sheyyease yad lachavero? teku.
Amar rabbi zera, hare amru: even shebbazzavit, keshehu choletz – choletz et kullah, ucheshehu notetz – notetz et shello umanniach et shel chavero.
Bae rabbi zera: mahu shettease yad lachavertah? teku.
Meta habbehema. may ikka ben ever min hachay leever (shel) [min] hannevela?
Ikka benayyhu basar happoresh mimmennu (meever behema), deillu basar happoresh meever min hachay – lo metamme, meever min hannevela – metamme.
Ever min hachay dimtamme, may kera? amar rav yehuda amar rav: "vechi yamut min habbehema".

Vehay mibbee leh lichiddach derav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la bematnita tana: "vechi yamut min habbehema" – miktzat behema metammea, umiktzat behema enah metammea, veezo zo? zo terefa sheshshechatah!
Im ken, lichtov rachamana "mibbehema", may "min habbehema"? shema minna tarte.

I hachi, afillu basar name? la salka datach, detanya: yachol yehe basar happoresh min hachay tame? talmud lomar "vechi yamut min habbehema" – ma mita sheenah osa chalifin, af kol sheeno ose chalifin, divre rabbi yose.
Rabbi akiva omer: "behema", ma behema – gidim vaatzamot, af kol – gidim vaatzamot. rabbi omer: "behema" ma behema – basar gidim vaatzamot, af kol – basar gidim vaatzamot.
May ikka ben rabbi lerabbi akiva? ikka benayyhu archubba.
Ben rabbi akiva lerabbi yose haggelili, may ikka benayyhu? amar rav pappa: kuleya veniv sefatayim ikka benayyhu.

Tanya name gabbe sheratzim kehay gavvna: yachol basar happoresh min hashsheratzim yehe tame? talmud lomar "bemotam" – ma mita sheenah osa chalifin, af kol sheenah osa chalifin. divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: "sheretz", ma sheretz – gidim vaatzamot, af kol – gidim vaatzamot. rabbi omer: "sheretz", ma sheretz – basar gidim vaatzamot, af kol – basar gidim vaatzamot.
Ben rabbi lerabbi akiva ikka benayyhu archubba. ben rabbi akiva lerabbi yose haggelili may ikka benayyhu? amar rav pappa: kuleya veniv sefatayim ikka benayyhu.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan behema – hayeynu tama delo metamme mechayyim, mishshum delo metamme bechaadasha, aval sheretz dimtamme bechaadasha – ema letamme mechayyim.
Vei ashmevinan sheretz, mishshum dela metamme bemassa – lo metamme mechayyim, aval behema, dimtamme bemassa – ema tetamme mechayyim, tzericha.
Tanu rabbanan: hachotech kezayit basar meever min hachay, chatacho veachar kach chishshev alav – tahor.
Chishshev alav, veachar kach chatacho – tame.
Rabbi assi la al leve midresha, ashkecheh lerabbi zera, amar leh: may amur beve midresha? amar leh: may kashya lach? amar leh, dekatane: chishshev veachar kach chatacho tame.

a: Tumeat bet hassetarim hi, vetumeat bet hassetarim la metammeya.
Amar leh: af ledidi kashya li, usheelteh lerabbi abba bar memel, veamar li: ha manni? rabbi meir hi, deamar: tumeat bet hassetarim metammeya.
Amar leh: velav zimnin saggiin amra kammay, vaamari leh: shane leh lerabbi meir ben tumea devaaya hechsher uven tumea dela baaya hechsher.
Amar rava: umay kusheya? dilma beshehucheshar.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan lerava: lema li hechsher, hare metamme tumea chamura aggav aviv?
Amar leh: kesheshshimmesh, maase etz shimmesh.
Amar abbaye: hare amru kofet seor sheyyichadah lishiva – batla.
Tumeatah lav deorayyta, dei salka datach deorayyta, matzinu loochalin shemmetammein tumea chamura, kesheshshimmesh – maase etz shimmesh.

Amar abbaye: hare amru tikrovet avoda zara shel ochalin metammein beohel, tumeatah lav deorayyta, dei salka datach deorayyta – matzinu loochalin shemmetammein tumea chamura! kesheshshimmesh – maase etz shimmesh.
Amar abbaye: hare amru chibbure ochalin kechelim damu, tumeatan lav deorayyta, dei salka datach deorayyta – matzinu leochel shemmetamme tumea chamura! kesheshshimmesh – maase etz shimmesh.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: ha detanya, chelev nevela bakkefarim tzarich machshava vehechsher, tumeato aggav kuleya lav deorayyta, dei salka datach deorayyta, matzinu leochel shemmetamme tumea chamura!
Kesheshshimmesh – maase etz shimmesh.
Amar rav matna: hare amru bayit shessikkecho bizraim – taheru. tumeato lav deorayyta, dei salka datach deorayyta – matzinu lizraim shemmetammein tumea chamura! kesheshshimmesh – maase etz shimmesh.
Rabbi shimon metaher.
Ma nafshach: i mita osa nippul – litamme mishshum ever min hachay, i en mita osa nippul – litamme mishshum ever min hannevela!
Rabbi shimon aresha kae: haever vehabbasar hameduledalin bivhema metamme tumeat ochalin bimkoman, utzerichin hechsher, verabbi shimon metaher.
Amar rabbi assi, amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? amar kera "mikkol haochel asher yeachel", ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim – karuy ochel, ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo
b: Laacherim – en karuy ochel.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: dilma tama derabbi shimon hatam, hoil umeore – meore.

Detanya: yichur shel teena shennifshach umeore bakkelippa – rabbi yehuda metaher, vachachamim omrim: im yachol lichyot – tahor, veim lav – tame. veamrinan lach: may tama derabbi yehuda? veamrat lan: hoil umeore – meore.
Amar leh, ammetziata: nishchata habbehema, hucheshra bedameha – divre rabbi meir; rabbi shimon omer: lo hucheshru.

(Amar rabbi assi) amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? amar kera "mikkol haochel asher yeachel" – ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim – karuy ochel, ochel sheen atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim – en karuy ochel.
Vedilma tama derabbi shimon behahi
I kidrava, i kidrabbi yochanan?
Ella, leolam assefa, velav aever, ella abbasar. meta habbehema – habbasar tzarich hechsher, verabbi shimon metaher.

Amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? amar kera "mikkol haochel asher yeachel", ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim – karuy ochel, ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim – en karuy ochel.

Mishna haever vehabbasar hameduledalin beadam – tehorim. met haadam – habbasar tahor. haever metamme mishshum ever min hachay, veeno metamme mishshum ever min hammet, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon metaher.
Gemara verabbi shimon ma nafshach? i mita osa nippul – litamme mishshum ever min hachay, vei en mita osa nippul – litamme mishshum ever min hammet!

Rabbi shimon bealma kae, dekaamar tanna kamma: haever metamme mishshum ever min hachay veen metamme mishshum ever min hammet, alma ever hammet bealma metamme, vaamar leh rabbi shimon: ever hammet bealma lo metamme.

Detanya: amar rabbi eliezer: shamati sheever min hachay metamme. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: min hachay velo min hammet? vekal vachomer – uma chay shehu tahor, ever happoresh mimmennu tame; met shehu tame, lo kol shekken?
Katuv bimgillat taanit: "pischa zeira dela lemispad", ha rabba lemispad?! ella kol dechen! hacha name, kol dechen! amar leh: kach shamati.
Umay ikka ben ever min hachay leever min hammet? kezayit basar veetzem kisora happoresh meever min hachay ikka benayyhu.

Ditnan: kezayit basar happoresh meever min hachay – rabbi eliezer metamme, verabbi nechuneya ben hakkana verabbi yehoshua metaharin. etzem kisora happoresh meever min hachay – rabbi nechuneya metamme, rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua metaharin.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, ben tanna kamma lerabbi shimon name, kezayit basar veetzem kisora ikka benayyhu.
Hadaran alach haor veharotev.

a: Mishna hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagin baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bachullin aval lo bammukedashin.
Shehaya baddin, uma im hachullin, sheenan chayyayvim bechaze vashok – chayyayvim bemattanot, kadashim, shechayyayvim bechaze vashok – eno din shechayyayvim bemattanot?
Talmud lomar: "vaetten otam leaharon hakkohen ulevanav lechok olam" – en lo ella ma sheamur bainyan.
Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan, venifdu – chayyayvin babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan.
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osin temura, veim metu – yippadu, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser.
Kol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over kodem lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad lahem mum kavua, venifdu – peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, veenan yotzin lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved.
Uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz – chayyayv, veosin temura, veim metu – yikkaveru.
Gemara tama dichtav rachamana "otam", ha lav hachi hava amena kadashim chayyayvin bemattanot?
Ikka lemifrach: ma lechullin shekken chayyayvin bivchora!
Tete mizzecharim – ma lizcharim, shekken chayyayvin bereshit haggez!
Mitteyayshim – ma lityayshim, shekken nichnasin laddir lehitasser!
