Mizzekenim – ma lizkenim, shekken nichnesu ledir lehitasser!
Millakuach veyatom – ma lelakuach veyatom, shekken nichnasin beminan laddir lehitasser!
Beminan kaamrat? kodashim name, beminan nichnasin laddir lehitasser.

Veyihyu chullin chayyayvin bechaze vashok mikkal vachomer: uma kadashim, sheen chayyayvim bemattanot, chayyayvin bechaze vashok; chullin, shechayyayvin bemattanot, eno din shechayyayvin bechaze vashok?
Amar kera: "veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim", "ze" – in, midde acharina – la.
Ella tama dichtav rachamana "ze", ha lav hachi hava amena chullin chayyayvin bechaze vashok? veha bae tenufa, hecha linufinhu? i abbaray – "lifne Adonai" ketiv,
b: I aggavvay – ka meayyel chullin laazara, hilkach la efshar.
Ella "ze" lema li? lechidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: hammazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan – patur milleshallem.
Gufa, amar rav chisda: hammazzik mattenot kehunna, o sheachalan – patur milleshallem. may tama? ibbaet ema dichtiv "ze", veibbaet ema mishshum dehave leh mamon sheen lo tovim.
Metivi: "veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim" – melammed shehammattanot din. lemay hilcheta? lav lehotzian bedayyaynin? la, lecholkan bedayyaynin.

Vechidrav shemuel bar nachmani, deamar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin sheen notnin mattana lechohen am haaretz? shenneemar: "vayyomer laam leyoshve yerushalim latet menat lakkohanim velalviyyim lemaan yechezku betorat Adonai", kol hammachzik betorat Adonai – yesh lo menat, vesheeno machazik betorat Adonai – en lo menat.
Ta shema: rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: "mishpat" – melammed shehammattanot din. yachol afillu chaze vashok din? talmud lomar "ze".
Lemay? ilema lecholko bedayyaynin – attu chaze vashok lav bedayyaynin michalleku? ella lav (lehotzi) [lehotzio] bedayyaynin.
Hacha bemay askinan, daato lideh. i daato lideh, may lememra? daato lideh betivlayyhu, vekasavar hay tanna: mattanot shello huremu – kemi shehuremu damyayn.
Ta shema: baal habbayit shehaya over mimmakom lemakom, vetzarich littol leket, shichcha, ufea, umasar ani – notel, velichsheyyachzor yeshallem, divre rabbi eliezer.
Amar rav chisda: middat chasidut shanu kan. amar rava: tanna tane "yeshallem", veat amrat middat chasidut shanu kan?! veod, midderabbi eliezer lekum veloytevv?
Ella missefa, vachachamim omrim: ani haya beotah shaa, tama deani, ha ashir – meshallem.
Ammay? leheve kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan! amar rav chisda: middat chasidut shanu kan.

Ta shema: minnayin levaal habbayit sheachal perotav tevalin, vechen levi sheachal maserotav tevalim, minnayin sheppatur min hattashlumin? talmud lomar: "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael asher yarimu" – en lecha bahen ella mishsheat harama veelach.
Ha mishsheat harama veelach miha meshallem, ammay? leheve kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan! hacha name

a: Daato lideh betivlayyhu, vekasavar hay tanna: mattanot shello huremu – kemi shehuremu damyayn.
Ta shema: hare sheansu bet hammelech gorno, im bechovo – chayyayv leasser, im beanparut – patur milleasser.
Shane hatam, deka mishtarshi leh.

Ta shema, amar lo: mechor li bene meeha shel para, vehaya bahen mattenot kehunna – notnan lakkohen, veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lakach hemennu bemishkal – notnan lakkohen, umenakke lo min haddamim.
Ammay? leheve kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan! shane hatam, deitanhu beenayhu.
Ta shema: tisha nichse chohen – teruma, uterumat maaser, vechalla, reshit haggez, umattanot, vehaddemay, vehabbikkurim, vehakkeren, vehachomesh.
Lemay, lav lehotzian bedayyaynin? la, lichditnan: lama amru nichse chohen? shekkone bahen avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea, uvaal chov notlan bechovo, veishsha bichtubbatah, vesefer tora.
Hahu levaa dahava chatef mattenata, ato amaru leh lerav, amar lehu: la missatyeh dela shaklinan minneh, ella michtaf name chatef?!
Verav, i ikkero "am" – mishkal name lishkol minnayyhu. i la ikkero "am" – rachamana patrinhu!
Mesappeka leh i ikkero "am" i la ikkero "am".

Yatev rav pappa vekaamar la leha shemata, etiveh rav idi bar avin lerav pappa: arba mattenot aniyyim shebbakkerem – happeret, vehaolelot, vehashshichcha, vehappea; veshalosh shebbattevua – halleket, vehashshichcha, vehappea; shenayim shebbailan – hashshichcha vehappea.
Kullan en bahem tovat hanaa labbealim, vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael motziin miyyado.

Masar ani hammitchallek betoch beto – yesh bo tovat hanaa labbealim, vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael motziin oto miyyado, ushear mattenot kehunna, kegon hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva – en motziin otan miyyado, lo mikkohen lechohen velo millevi lelevi.
Arba mattanot shebbakkerem: happeret, vehaolelot, vehashshichcha, vehappea, dichtiv: "vecharmecha lo teolel uferet karmecha lo telakket".
Uchetiv: "ki tivtzor karmecha lo teolel acharecha", amar rabbi levi: "acharecha" – zo shichcha.
Pea – gamar "acharecha" "acharecha" mizzayit, dichtiv: "ki tachbot zetcha lo tefaer acharecha", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: shello tittol tifarto mimmennu.
Shelosha shebbattevua: halleket,
b: Hashshichcha, vehappea, dichtiv: "uvekutzrechem et ketzir artzechem lo techalle peat sadcha bekutzrecha veleket ketzircha vegomer", "ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha veshachachta omer bassade".
Shenayim shebbailan: hashshichcha vehappea, dichtiv "ki tachbot zetcha lo tefaer acharecha", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: shello tittol tifarto mimmennu, "acharecha" – zo shichcha.
Vechullan en bahen tovat hanaa livalim, may tama? "aziva" ketiva behu.
Vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael, motziin oto miyyado, dichtiv: "veleket ketzircha lo telakket leani velagger taazov otam", lehazehir ani al shello.
Umasar ani hammitchallek betoch habbayit yesh bo tovat hanaa labbealim, may tama? "netina" ketiva beh.
Vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael motziin oto miyyado, deamar rabbi ila: gamar "lagger" "lagger" mehatam, ma lehallan muzehar ani al shello, af kan muzehar ani al shello.
Ushear mattenot kehunna, kegon hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva, en motziin otan lo mikkohen lechohen velo millevi lelevi. ha millevi lechohen motziin, alma ikkeru "am".
Kegon hazzeroa velo zeroa, umay nihu – maaser rishon.
Maaser rishon delevi hu? kerabbi elazar ben azarya, detanya: teruma lakkohen, maaser rishon lallevi, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: af lakkohen.
Emar deamar rabbi elazar ben azarya af lakkohen, lakkohen velo lallevi mi amar? in, levatar dekansinhu ezra.
Emar dekansinhu ezra – dela yahavinan lehu mishkal minnayyhu mi amar?! ella, kegon zeroa velo zeroa, umay nihu – reshit haggez.

Ta shema, ze hakkelal: kol davar shehu bikdushsha, kegon teruma uterumat maaser vechalla – motziin otan miyyadam, vechol davar sheeno bikdushsha, kegon hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva – en motziin oto miyyadam.
Kegon zeroa velo zeroa, umay nihu – maaser rishon, ulevatar dekansinhu ezra.
Ta shema: hashshochet lechohen ulegoy – patur min hammattanot, ha lelevi uleyisrael – chayyayv? la tema ha lelevi uleyisrael chayyayv, ella ema: ha leyisrael – chayyayv.

Aval lelevi may patur? i hachi, litne "hashshochet lallevi velaggoy patur min hammattanot". veod, ha tanya: hashshochet lakkohen velaggoy – patur min hammattanot, lallevi uleyisrael – chayyayv! teyuveta derav.
Amar lecha rav: tannae hi, detanya: "vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh" – ze lifnay velifnim.
"Ohel moed" – ze hechol, "mizbeach" – kemashmao, "yechapper" – ellu azarot, "kohanim" – kemashmao, "am hakkahal" – ellu yisrael, "yechapper" – ellu haleviyyim.
Vetanya iddach: "yechapper" – ellu avadim. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar ikkero "am", umar savar la ikkero "am".
Verav, i sevira leh kehay tanna – lema, vei sevira leh kehay tanna – lema! mesappeka leh i kehay tanna i kehay tanna.
Derash marimar: hilcheta kevavteh derav, vehilcheta kevavteh derav chisda.
Ulla hava yahev mattenata lechahanta, etiveh rava leulla: minchat kohenet – neechelet, minchat kohen – enah neechelet.
Vei amrat "kohen" vaafillu kohenet, vehachtiv: "vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel"! amar leh: rabbi,

a: Mittunach: "aharon uvanav" ketuvin bapparasha.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "kohen" – velo kohenet, veyilmod satum min hameforash.
Deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov tana: "kohen", vaafillu kohenet – have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot.
Rav kahana achal bishvil ishto, rav pappa achal bishvil ishto, rav yemar achal bishvil ishto, rav idi bar avin achal bishvil ishto.
Amar ravina: amar li marimar, hilcheta kevavteh derav, vehilcheta kevavteh derav chisda, vehilcheta kevavteh deulla.
Vehilcheta kevavteh derav adda bar ahava: leviyya sheyyalda – benah patur mechamesh selaim.

Tanu rabbanan: hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagim bechilayim uvechoy. rabbi eliezer omer: kilayim habba min haez umin harachel – chayyayv bemattanot, min hattayish umin hatztzeviyyay – patur min hammattanot.
Mikkede kayyma lan dilinyan kissuy haddam umattanot la mashkachat leh ella bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha, uven lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan mesappeka lehu i choshshin lezera haav, i en choshshin.
Uvese vaafillu miktzat se kamippalgi: mar savar: "se" – vaafillu miktzat se, umar savar: "se" vaafillu miktzat se la amrinan.

Bishlama rabbi eliezer defatar, kasavar "se" velo miktzat se, ella lerabbanan, nehi name dekasavri "se" vaafillu miktzat se, palga lishkol, veiddach palga lema leh: ayyti reaya deen choshshin lezera haav ushekol! amar rav huna bar chiyyay: may chayyayv name deka amar – chayyayv bachatzi mattanot.
Metiv rabbi zera: koy – yesh bo derachim shavin labbehema, veyesh bo derachim shavin lachayya, veyesh bo derachim shavin lachayya velabbehema.

Ketzad? chelbo asur kachalev behema, vedamo chayyayv lechassot kedam hachayya, derachim shavin labbehema velachayya – sheddamo vegido asurin kivhema vechayya, vechayyayv bizroa ulechayayim vehakkeva, verabbi eliezer poter.
Veim ita, chayyayv bachatzi mattanot mibbee leh! ayyeyde ditna chelbo vedamo, dela mittene "chatzi" "chatzi", mishshum hachi la ka tane "chatzi".

Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: koy lerabbanan chayyayv bechullehu mattanot, detanya: "shor", ma talmud lomar "im shor" – lerabbot et hakkilayim. "se", ma talmud lomar "im se" – lerabbot et hakkoy.
Verabbi eliezer, hay "im" lema li? mibbee leh lechallek. verabbanan, lechallek mena lehu? nafka lehu meet zovche hazzevach".
Verabbi eliezer, hay "meet zovche hazzevach" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrava, deamar rava: haddin im hattabbach.
Mishna bechor shennitarev bemea, bizman shemmea shochatin et kullan – potrim et kullan, echad shochet et kullan – potrim lo echad.
Hashshochet lakkohen velaggoy – patur min hammattanot, vehammishtattef immahen – tzarich sheyyirshom, veim amar: "chutz min hammattanot" – patur min hammattanot.
Amar: "mechor li bene meeha shel para", vehayu bahen mattanot – notnan lakkohen, veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lekachan hemennu bemishkal – notnan lakkohen, umenakke lo min haddamim.
Gemara veammay? yavo alav kohen mishshene tzedadin, velema leh: i bechor hu – kulleh didi hu, vei lav bechor hu – hav li mattenatay.
b: Amar rav oshaya: beva lide kohen umecharo leyisrael bemumo.
Hashshochet lakkohen velaggoy, patur min hammattanot. velitne: kohen vegoy peturin min hammattanot? amar rava: zot omeret, haddin im hattabbach.
Daresh rava: "meet haam" – velo meet hakkohanim, keshehu omer "meet zovche hazzevach" – heve omer afillu tabbach kohen bammashma.
Ushepizchaneh derabbi tavla kohen hava, vahava dechik leh milleta. ata lekammeh derabbi tavla, amar leh: zil ishtattaf bahade tabbache yisrael, demiggo demippatri mimmattenata, mishtattefi bahadach.
Chayyeyveh rav nachman, amar leh: veha rabbi tavla patran! amar leh: zil appek, vei la – mappekna lach rabbi tavla meunnach.

Azal rabbi tavla kammeh derav nachman, amar leh: may tama aved mar hachi? amar leh: dechi ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, zikne darom amru: kohen tabbach – shetayim veshalosh shabbatot patur min hammattanot, mikkan veelach chayyayv bemattanot.
Amar leh: velaaved leh mar mihat kerabbi acha bar chanina! amar leh: hane mille dela keva mesachta, aval hacha ha keva mesachta.
Amar rav chisda: hay kahana dela mafresh mattenata – leheve beshamta deelahe yisrael. amar rabba bar rav shela: hane tabbache dehutzal kayymi beshamta derav chisda ha esrim vetarte shenin.

Lemay hilcheta? illema detu la meshammetinan lehu – veha tanya: bamme devarim amurim? bemitzvat lo taase, aval bemitzvat ase, kegon omrim lo "ase sukka" veeno ose, "lulav" veeno ose, "ase tzitzit" veeno ose – makkin oto ad shettetze nafsho!
Ella, dekansinan lehu bela atrayyta, ki ha derava kanes atma, rav nachman bar yitzchak kanes gelima.
Veamar rav chisda: zeroa leechad, vekeva leechad, lechayayim lishnayim. ini? veha ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar: bemareva palginan lehu garma garma!
Hatam bidtora.

Amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: asur leechol mibbehema shello hurema mattenoteha. amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: kol haochel mibbehema shello hurema mattenoteha – keillu ochel tevalim, velet hilcheta kevavteh.
Amar rav chisda: mattenot kehunna en neechalot ella tzali, veen neechalot ella bechardal. may tama? amar kera: "lemoshcha" – ligdulla, kederech shehammelachim ochlim.

Veamar rav chisda: esrim vearba mattenot kehunna, kol kohen sheeno baki bahen – en notnin lo mattana. velav milleta hi, detanya: rabbi shimon omer: kol kohen sheeno mode baavoda – en lo chelek bakkehunna, shenneemar: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana".

En li ella ze bilvad, minnayin lerabbot chamesh esre avodot, kegon: hayyetzikot, vehabbelilot, vehappetitot, vehammelichot, tenufot, vehaggashot, [vehakkemitzot], haketarot, (vehammetziyyot), [vehammelikot],
